title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选：AI × Chem 16 项，AI × Bio 14 项，AI × Math 15 项，AI Voices 10 项，Engineering 6 项。共同日期为2026-10-02。AI×Chem前三项均为arXiv预印本，聚焦分子晶体生成、结构偏移下的性质预测与单步逆合成；AI×Bio前三项均为medRxiv/bioRxiv预印本，涉及临床仪表板、CASR变异分类和卒中单细胞信号。AI×Math关注形式化证明与推理基准；AI Voices为X公开观点或机构发布；Engineering前三为GitHub Trending项目而非版本发布。前三项未见足够高质量的同行评议论文。

channel_highlights.aixmath: 前三项均为arXiv预印本，聚焦文档级形式化、可撤销推理基准及Rocq/Lean证明工具接口。
channel_highlights.aivoices: 前三项是X上的公开观点或机构发布：Chollet谈长思维模型，Anthropic转发科学计算观点，AI2宣布Olmo-core 3。
channel_highlights.engineering: 前三项均是GitHub Trending项目：Cursor插件、TileLang内核DSL、UniMate跨骨架动画；这是趋势快照，不等同于版本发布。

items.title: Riemannian Flow Models with Reinforcement Learning for Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Crystal structure governs material properties, making crystal structure prediction (CSP) a fundamental problem in materials science. Generative models are a promising approach for solving this problem, but the prevalence of polymorphism, coupled with large unit cells and complex packing geometry, makes the molecular CSP task challenging for existing models. To address this, we introduce Coarse-Grained Open Materials Generation (CG-OMatG), an equivariant Riemannian flow-based generative model. CG-OMatG predicts molecular crystal structures via a coarse-grained, hierarchical representation. CG-OMatG treats molecules as rigid bodies---performing both inter- and intra-molecular message passing to construct a geometric representation for molecular packings---and learns to reconstruct molecule centroid positions, orientations, and lattice parameters, conditioned on chemical species and conformer geometry. We train the model on subsets of the Open Molecular Crystals (OMC25) and Cambridge Structural Database (CSD) datasets. Further, we fine-tune the model via policy gradient reinforcement learning to steer the model towards generating low-energy candidate structures. We validate the generated structures on the CSP blind test benchmark, assessing agreement with experimentally determined crystals using COMPACK packing-similarity analysis. CG-OMatG exhibits strong performance for generative molecular crystal structure prediction, paving the way for accelerated polymorph screening and organic solid-state materials discovery.
items.summary_zh: 提出CG-OMatG，一种等变Riemannian flow生成模型，以粗粒度层级表示和刚性分子体建模分子晶体堆积，并用策略梯度强化学习引导生成低能候选结构；在OMC25、CSD数据集和CSP盲测基准上进行了验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将分子晶体的复杂堆积几何、构象和低能目标纳入统一生成框架，直接面向多晶型筛选和有机固态材料发现。盲测与COMPACK结果提供了较强计算验证，但摘要未说明候选晶体的独立实验合成验证，且目前为预印本。
items.abstract_zh: 晶体结构决定材料性质，因此晶体结构预测（CSP）是材料科学中的基础问题。生成模型是解决这一问题的有前景方法，但多晶型普遍存在，加上大的晶胞和复杂的堆积几何，使分子CSP对现有模型而言仍然具有挑战性。为此，我们提出粗粒度开放材料生成（Coarse-Grained Open Materials Generation，CG-OMatG），一种基于等变Riemannian flow的生成模型。CG-OMatG通过粗粒度的层级表示预测分子晶体结构。该模型将分子视为刚性实体，通过分子间和分子内消息传递构建分子堆积的几何表示，并在给定化学种类和构象几何的条件下学习重建分子质心位置、取向和晶格参数。我们在Open Molecular Crystals（OMC25）和Cambridge Structural Database（CSD）的子集上训练模型。此外，我们通过策略梯度强化学习对模型进行微调，引导其生成低能候选结构。我们在CSP盲测基准上验证生成结构，并使用COMPACK堆积相似性分析评估其与实验测定晶体的一致性。CG-OMatG在生成式分子晶体结构预测方面表现出较强性能，为加速多晶型筛选和有机固态材料发现铺平了道路。
items.author_line: Thomas Egg, Harry Winston Sullivan, Maya M. Martirossyan, Philipp Höllmer, Cheng Zeng, Adrian Roitberg, Mingjie Liu, Richard Hennig, Sapna Sarupria, Ellad B. Tadmor, Stefano Martiniani

items.title: Molecular Property Prediction under Structural Shift with Tabular Foundation Models
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting molecular properties for compounds that differ structurally from labeled training molecules is important for drug discovery and materials design. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) offer a promising approach through in-context learning, but their performance under structural shifts and the value of molecular comparisons in this setting remain underexplored. We study structural generalization in molecular property prediction and introduce MolPAIR (Molecular Pair-Augmented In-context Refinement), a framework that combines molecule-level and molecular-pair contexts without task-specific parameter updates. A global tabular foundation model (TFM) first predicts a query's property from labeled molecular examples. A second frozen TFM predicts differences in prediction errors between the query and labeled reference molecules, using these comparisons to refine the initial prediction. Across 58 MoleculeACE and Polaris tasks, CheMeleon representations combined with TabPFN-3 already outperform each evaluated baseline on a majority of tasks. MOLPAIR further improves this predictor on 46 of 58 tasks, with gains across four molecular representations and three TFM backbones. These results show that explicit molecular comparisons can strengthen tabular in-context learning for structural generalization while keeping the molecular encoder and pretrained model weights fixed. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/nums-ai/MolPAIR.
items.summary_zh: 提出MolPAIR，将分子级上下文与分子对比较结合到无需任务特定参数更新的表格基础模型中，用第二个冻结模型预测查询分子与参考分子之间的误差差异，以改进结构分布外的性质预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对药物发现常见的结构分布偏移问题，方法在58个MoleculeACE和Polaris任务中的46个任务上进一步提升性能，并保持分子编码器和基础模型权重不变。限制是结果主要来自基准任务，尚未体现真实先导优化中的前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 对于与带标签训练分子在结构上不同的化合物，预测其分子性质对药物发现和材料设计都很重要。表格基础模型（TFM）可以通过上下文学习提供有前景的方法，但其在结构偏移下的性能以及分子比较在此场景中的价值仍未得到充分研究。我们研究分子性质预测中的结构泛化，并提出MolPAIR（Molecular Pair-Augmented In-context Refinement），一种结合分子级上下文和分子对上下文的框架，无需任务特定的参数更新。一个全局表格基础模型（TFM）首先根据带标签的分子示例预测查询分子的性质；第二个冻结的TFM随后利用查询分子与带标签参考分子之间的比较，预测二者预测误差的差异，并据此修正初始预测。在58个MoleculeACE和Polaris任务中，结合CheMeleon表示与TabPFN-3已经在大多数任务上超过所有被评估的基线。MOLPAIR在58个任务中的46个任务上进一步提升了该预测器，并且在四种分子表示和三种TFM骨干网络上都获得了增益。这些结果表明，显式的分子比较可以增强表格上下文学习在结构泛化方面的能力，同时保持分子编码器和预训练模型权重不变。代码和数据集已在https://github.com/nums-ai/MolPAIR提供。
items.author_line: Jinmo Lee, Dooho Lee, Minho Jeong, Jaemin Yoo

items.title: RetroGEF: Dynamic Graph Edit Flow for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
items.abstract_or_text: Retrosynthesis enables the discovery of viable synthetic routes to target molecules. It plays a central role in modern drug discovery and materials design. Retrosynthesis involves molecular graph transformations that can change both connectivity and graph size. These transformations may introduce reactant components absent from the target while revising the product-derived structure. To model these transformations, we propose RetroGEF, a flow-based generative model for single-step retrosynthesis. Starting from the target molecule, it constructs possible reactants by adding atoms and changing bonds in the molecular graph. RetroGEF models molecular transformations and changes in graph size within the same generative process, rather than relying on a fixed-size graph canvas. It learns this process directly from product--reactant pairs without requiring a prescribed edit order. Experiments on representative retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroGEF achieves state-of-the-art performance.
items.summary_zh: 提出RetroGEF，一种动态图编辑流生成模型，从目标分子出发在同一生成过程中增添原子并改变化学键，直接学习产物—反应物对而无需预先规定编辑顺序，用于单步逆合成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把分子连接变化和图规模变化统一到一个生成过程，减少固定图画布和人为编辑顺序带来的限制，并在代表性逆合成基准上达到当前最佳性能。摘要未提供路线可合成性或实验执行验证。
items.abstract_zh: 逆合成能够发现目标分子的可行合成路线，在现代药物发现和材料设计中发挥核心作用。逆合成涉及分子图变换，这些变换既可能改变连接关系，也可能改变图的规模；它们可以引入目标分子中不存在的反应物组分，同时修改从产物继承的结构。为建模这些变换，我们提出RetroGEF，一种用于单步逆合成的基于流的生成模型。该模型从目标分子出发，通过在分子图中添加原子和改变化学键来构建可能的反应物。RetroGEF在同一个生成过程中对分子变换和图规模变化进行建模，而不是依赖固定大小的图画布。它直接从产物—反应物对中学习，无需预先规定编辑顺序。在代表性逆合成基准上的实验表明，RetroGEF达到了当前最佳性能。
items.author_line: Xiaozhuang Song, Xuemin Chen, Xinjian Zhao, Yaoyao Xu, Tianshu Yu

items.title: Autocata: Reaction-network-guided autonomous catalyst screening via capability-centric AI
items.abstract_or_text: Artificial intelligence (AI) has expanded the accessible space for catalyst discovery, yet executing complex screening campaigns still requires constant human intervention to bridge high-level reaction objectives with underlying computational pipelines. Here, we present Autocata, a knowledge-embedded autonomous agent that scales catalytic expertise by encoding multistep reaction pathways into reusable, language-invocable capabilities. Powered by a Transformer pretrained on two million catalyst-adsorbate structures, the system incorporates a capability registry of 79 adsorbate-specialized generative models spanning complex reaction networks across carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, and hydrogen intermediates. Given a high-level natural-language prompt, Autocata deconstructs reaction networks, queries and configures matching generative models, generates candidate surface configurations, enforces physical and geometric validity filtering, and coordinates machine-learning potentials evaluations to rank promising materials. Crucially, the agent adaptively reconfigures workflows when encountering capability boundaries or task bottlenecks. We demonstrate these capabilities across CH4 activation, nitrogen reduction reaction (N2RR), and CO2-to-methanol pathways. By shifting from static toolkits to an adaptive, language-driven computational infrastructure, Autocata lowers the barrier for expert-level catalyst discovery and offers a scalable paradigm for self-driving catalytic research.
items.summary_zh: 提出Autocata，一个知识嵌入的自主催化剂筛选智能体，将多步反应路径编码为可复用、可由语言调用的能力；系统可拆解反应网络、配置79个专用生成模型、过滤物理和几何无效结构，并用机器学习势排序候选材料。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把高层反应目标与催化剂表面生成、物理筛选和势能评估连接起来，展示了面向CH4活化、N2RR和CO2制甲醇的自适应计算工作流。证据目前主要是计算演示，尚缺乏实验催化性能或跨体系稳健性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）扩大了催化剂发现的可探索空间，但执行复杂筛选活动仍需要持续的人为干预，以在高层反应目标与底层计算流程之间建立连接。在此，我们提出Autocata，一个知识嵌入的自主智能体，通过将多步反应路径编码为可复用、可由语言调用的能力来扩展催化专业知识。该系统由在200万个催化剂—吸附物结构上预训练的Transformer驱动，并包含一个能力注册表，其中有79个针对特定吸附物的生成模型，覆盖涉及碳、氮、氧和氢中间体的复杂反应网络。给定高层自然语言提示后，Autocata会拆解反应网络，查询并配置匹配的生成模型，生成候选表面构型，执行物理和几何有效性过滤，并协调机器学习势能评估以对有希望的材料进行排序。关键是，当遇到能力边界或任务瓶颈时，该智能体能够自适应地重新配置工作流。我们在CH4活化、氮还原反应（N2RR）和CO2制甲醇路径上展示了这些能力。通过从静态工具包转向自适应、语言驱动的计算基础设施，Autocata降低了专家级催化剂发现的门槛，并为自主催化研究提供了可扩展范式。
items.author_line: Ruili Li, Rui Qi, Qingqing Mao, Ritankar Das, Beien Zhu, Yi Gao

items.title: Smart Machine Learning for Solving the Full Electron-Nuclear Schrödinger Equation with a Quantum-Chemically Inspired Wavefunction Ansatz
items.abstract_or_text: Directly solving the full electron-nuclear Schrödinger equation remains one of the grand challenges in quantum mechanics. Here, we propose a quantum-chemically motivated orbital-based neural network wavefunction ansatz with explicit many-body electron-electron correlation terms, with parameters depending on the entire electron-nuclear configuration, enabling an accurate description of strongly correlated and/or multi-reference electronic structures by a single Slater-determinant across a broad nuclear configuration space. To train this wavefunction, we further develop an efficient hybrid optimization strategy that combines the variational Monte Carlo technique with local-energy constraints, mitigating the intrinsic sampling bias of the former and considerably reducing the statistical error. These advances are embedded in a unified neural network framework, Schrödinger, enabling the determination of globally accurate potential energy surfaces with a single training for systems ranging from strongly correlated diatomic molecules, triatomic reactions containing conical intersections, to polyatomic multi-reference molecules. This work offers a practical machine-learning tool for solving the electron-nuclear Schrödinger equation and capturing full quantum effects beyond the Born-Oppenheimer approximation.
items.summary_zh: 提出量子化学启发的轨道神经网络波函数以及结合变分蒙特卡洛和局域能量约束的混合优化策略，用单一Slater行列式描述强关联和多参考电子结构，并在统一框架中求解全电子—核Schrödinger方程。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法试图超越Born–Oppenheimer近似，在一个训练模型中处理强关联分子、含圆锥交叉的反应和多参考多原子体系，具有量子化学基础模型潜力。需要留意的是，摘要未给出具体误差、体系规模或与高精度参考方法的定量比较。
items.abstract_zh: 直接求解完整的电子—核Schrödinger方程仍然是量子力学中的重大挑战之一。在此，我们提出一种受量子化学启发、基于轨道的神经网络波函数试探形式，其中显式包含多体电子—电子关联项，参数取决于完整的电子—核构型，使得单一Slater行列式能够在广泛的核构型空间内准确描述强关联和/或多参考电子结构。为了训练这一波函数，我们进一步开发了一种高效的混合优化策略，将变分蒙特卡洛技术与局域能量约束相结合，从而减轻前者固有的采样偏差并显著降低统计误差。这些进展被整合进统一的神经网络框架Schrödinger中，使得模型能够通过一次训练确定全局准确的势能面，适用于从强关联双原子分子、包含圆锥交叉的三原子反应，到多参考多原子分子等体系。这项工作提供了一种求解电子—核Schrödinger方程的实用机器学习工具，并能够捕捉超越Born–Oppenheimer近似的完整量子效应。
items.author_line: Yaolong Zhang, Bin Jiang, Hua Guo

items.title: Nuclear quantum effects enhance diffusion in supercooled ammonia through accelerated pyramidal inversion
items.abstract_or_text: In liquid ammonia, an imbalance between available hydrogen-bond donor and acceptor sites limits water-like tetrahedral connectivity, leaving sparse and short-lived associations within a densely packed liquid. We ask whether quantum-sensitive local rearrangements can nevertheless contribute appreciably to diffusion in this weakly connected liquid. We compare classical and thermostatted ring polymer molecular dynamics from 170 to 250 K using an r^2SCAN-trained machine learning force field. Ammonia can change its molecular geometry as the nitrogen atom passes through the plane of the three hydrogen atoms, a motion known as pyramidal inversion. Nuclear quantum effects increase the inversion rate and reduce its apparent activation energy. Inversion events are accompanied by transient reductions in hydrogen-bond coordination and local density within the first solvation shell. Although nuclear quantum effects lower density and viscosity throughout the studied range, diffusion remains only weakly affected in the warmer liquid. The quantum enhancement of diffusion emerges below approximately 210 K and reaches 18% at 170 K, tracking the enhancement of cage escape. These observations support an inversion-assisted contribution to diffusion, in which a spatially localized, quantum-sensitive internal motion couples to cage relaxation without a persistent tetrahedral network.
items.summary_zh: 使用以r2SCAN训练的机器学习力场和经典/恒温环聚合物分子动力学，研究过冷氨中的核量子效应；发现量子效应通过加速氨的伞式反转，在170 K使扩散增强18%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将局域的量子敏感内部运动与笼状松弛和扩散联系起来，为弱氢键网络液体中的输运机制提供了可检验解释。结论来自模拟，力场质量、有限温度范围及与实验输运数据的一致性仍需进一步评估。
items.abstract_zh: 在液氨中，可用的氢键供体和受体位点不平衡，限制了类似水的四面体连接，使致密液体中的缔合稀疏且短暂。我们探讨量子敏感的局域重排是否仍能对这种弱连接液体的扩散产生显著贡献。我们在170至250 K范围内，使用以r2SCAN训练的机器学习力场，比较了经典分子动力学和恒温环聚合物分子动力学。氨分子可以改变其几何构型，使氮原子穿过三个氢原子所在的平面，这一运动称为伞式反转。核量子效应提高了反转速率并降低其表观活化能。反转事件伴随着第一溶剂化壳层中氢键配位和局部密度的短暂降低。尽管核量子效应在整个研究温度范围内降低了密度和黏度，但在较暖的液体中扩散受到的影响很小。量子对扩散的增强在约210 K以下出现，并在170 K达到18%，与笼逃逸的增强相一致。这些观察结果支持这样一种反转辅助扩散的贡献机制：空间局域、对量子效应敏感的内部运动与笼状松弛耦合，而不需要持续存在的四面体网络。
items.author_line: Minwoo Kim, Hido Woo, Taeyong Park, Ji Woong Yu, Won Bo Lee

items.title: AmyloCore-ML: AI/Machine Learning Enabled Identification of Amyloid Fibril Core Regions Using Protein Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: In many neurodegenerative and systemic disorders, proteins can form insoluble protein aggregates called amyloids. Identification of amyloid forming regions in a protein remains central to understanding of its aggregation behaviour. Many predictors have been formed in the past and until recently which to estimate the aggregation-prone regions, which may not correspond to total residues found in actual disease associated fibril structures. To address this, we formed a sequence-based based predictor to ascertain structural amyloid-core propensity. The predictor was developed using experimentally determined fibril structures obtained from Amyloid Atlas. Ordered residues in the experimental structures were designated as core, and unresolved sampled from the same proteins as matched controls as non-core. Core and non-core regions were encoded using various physicochemical descriptors and protein language model (PLM) embeddings (ESM-2, ANKH, ProtT5) and evaluated using protein-grouped cross-validation. PLMs consistently outperformed physicochemical descriptors, with the best models reaching AUROC values of ~0.88 and AUPRC values of ~0.85. Locked full-length protein scans further localized experimental cores, with ESM-2/ExtraTrees W21 achieving AUROC 0.833, AUPRC 0.751, and a mean peak distance of 12.4 residues. In comparative benchmarking, our predictor showed better performance metrics than CrossBeta and AggrescanAI. The framework therefore provides residue-resolved prediction of structurally incorporated amyloid-core regions directly from sequence. AmyloCore-ML is easily accessible through an interactive Google Colab notebook, enabling sequence-based amyloid fibril-core prediction without local installation or dedicated computing infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 基于Amyloid Atlas实验纤维结构构建AmyloCore-ML，利用ESM-2、ANKH和ProtT5等蛋白语言模型嵌入预测序列中的结构性淀粉样蛋白核心区域，并通过蛋白分组交叉验证和全长扫描与CrossBeta、AggrescanAI比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把实际纤维结构中有序残基定义的核心区域与序列预测结合，提供残基分辨率的淀粉样核心定位，且模型可通过Google Colab使用。性能仍依赖训练结构覆盖范围，摘要未说明对独立疾病蛋白或实验突变的验证。
items.abstract_zh: 在许多神经退行性和全身性疾病中，蛋白质可以形成称为淀粉样蛋白的不溶性蛋白聚集体。识别蛋白质中的淀粉样形成区域，对于理解其聚集行为仍然至关重要。过去已经形成了许多预测器，用于估计易聚集区域，但这些区域可能不对应于实际疾病相关纤维结构中发现的全部残基。为此，我们构建了一个基于序列的预测器，用于确定结构性淀粉样核心倾向。该预测器使用从Amyloid Atlas获得的实验测定纤维结构开发。实验结构中的有序残基被定义为核心，并从相同蛋白质中将未解析残基抽样作为匹配的非核心对照。核心和非核心区域使用各种理化描述符以及蛋白语言模型（PLM）嵌入（ESM-2、ANKH、ProtT5）进行编码，并通过按蛋白质分组的交叉验证进行评估。PLM始终优于理化描述符，最佳模型的AUROC约为0.88，AUPRC约为0.85。锁定的全长蛋白扫描进一步定位了实验核心，其中ESM-2/ExtraTrees W21达到AUROC 0.833、AUPRC 0.751，平均峰值距离为12.4个残基。在比较基准测试中，我们的预测器显示出优于CrossBeta和AggrescanAI的性能指标。因此，该框架可以直接从序列对结构中实际形成的淀粉样核心区域进行残基分辨率预测。AmyloCore-ML可通过交互式Google Colab笔记本轻松使用，无需本地安装或专用计算基础设施即可进行基于序列的淀粉样纤维核心预测。
items.author_line: Singh, J., Jangid, R., Srivastava, A.

items.title: Structure-aware Reinforcement Learning for Protein Directed Evolution
items.abstract_or_text: Protein optimization remains a longstanding goal in life sciences. Existing machine learning-assisted directed evolution (MLDE) methods primarily rely on sequence-only features, overlooking the critical spatial constraints and co-evolutionary interactions encoded in protein structures. However, directly integrating structural information remains challenging due to the scarcity of reliable mutant structures. To address these issues, we propose StructEvo, a novel structure-aware reinforcement learning framework for protein directed evolution. StructEvo employs a delta-structure fusion encoder to approximate mutant structure features via feature differences, enabling dynamic incorporation of spatial knowledge. The vast mutation space is then decomposed into manageable subspaces through a structure-aligned hierarchical action network, while a geometric constraint further stabilizes delta feature learning. Our approach outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods by 9.2% and 16.3% on two challenging optimization benchmarks, and further identifies an experimentally validated epistasis pattern in GFP, highlighting the importance of structural guidance for effective protein directed evolution.
items.summary_zh: 提出StructEvo结构感知强化学习框架，用delta-structure融合编码器近似突变体结构特征，并以结构对齐的层级动作网络搜索突变空间；在两个优化基准上超过既有最佳方法，并在GFP中实验验证了上位性模式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把蛋白质空间约束和协同进化信息引入定向进化，兼顾突变空间规模与结构可行性；9.2%和16.3%的基准提升以及GFP实验结果增强了可信度。仍需在更多蛋白骨架和更大规模实验库上验证泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质优化一直是生命科学中的长期目标。现有机器学习辅助定向进化（MLDE）方法主要依赖仅基于序列的特征，忽略了蛋白质结构中编码的关键空间约束和协同进化相互作用。然而，由于可靠突变体结构稀缺，直接整合结构信息仍然具有挑战性。为解决这些问题，我们提出StructEvo，一种结构感知的蛋白质定向进化强化学习框架。StructEvo采用delta-structure融合编码器，通过特征差异近似突变体结构特征，从而实现空间知识的动态整合。随后，结构对齐的层级动作网络将庞大的突变空间分解为可管理的子空间，而几何约束进一步稳定delta特征学习。我们的方法在两个具有挑战性的优化基准上分别超过此前的最佳方法9.2%和16.3%，并进一步在GFP中发现了一个经过实验验证的上位性模式，凸显了结构引导对于有效蛋白质定向进化的重要性。
items.author_line: Zikun Nie, Suyuan Zhao, Yizhen Luo, Siqi Fan, Zaiqing Nie

items.title: Repurposing drugs for multi-target treatment of cytokine storm using machine learning
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS) is a major driver of acute organ failure in critical care settings, affecting approximately 49 million people and killing approximately 11 million people annually. Targeting multiple dysregulated feedback loops via single-molecule polypharmacology offers a promising strategy to blunt excessive immune activation and treat CRS-induced medical conditions such as sepsis. Methods: We used a computational workflow that combined machine-learning classification and molecular docking to identify multi-target modulators of NLRP3, IKBKB, JAK1, CCR5, and SIGMAR1. To eliminate data leakage, feature selection was strictly embedded within a 10-fold cross-validation loop. Candidates were structurally evaluated for binding affinity and active-site contact residues. Results: The model achieved an accuracy of 95.0% to 99.6% and an area under the receiver-operating curve (AUROC) of 0.995 to 1.000 across all five proteins, demonstrating robust generalization. Multiple compounds with average model-predicted scores above 0.50 across all five proteins were discovered. Docking analyses confirmed that the top candidates had favorable binding energetics, displaying stronger binding affinity than known protein inhibitors. Namely, Simeprevir had an average docking score of -10.3 kcal/mol. Shared key contact residues across drug candidates further support the validity of these docking scores and promise interesting in vitro work. Conclusion: Single-drug, multi-target inhibition effectively modulates interconnected inflammatory loops that drive the sepsis-related cytokine storm. This approach provides an alternative to multi-drug combination therapy in intensive care medicine.
items.summary_zh: 结合机器学习分类和分子对接，从NLRP3、IKBKB、JAK1、CCR5和SIGMAR1五个靶点中筛选可能同时调节多条炎症通路的药物再利用候选物，其中Simeprevir的平均对接评分为-10.3 kcal/mol。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 尝试用单分子多靶点药理学替代部分联合用药，为细胞因子释放综合征和脓毒症相关炎症提供候选线索。模型和对接结果不能替代体外、动物或临床验证，摘要明确将后续实验作为必要步骤。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：细胞因子释放综合征（CRS）是重症监护环境中急性器官衰竭的主要驱动因素之一，每年约影响4900万人并导致约1100万人死亡。通过单分子多重药理学靶向多个失调的反馈回路，是缓解过度免疫激活并治疗CRS诱发医学状况（如脓毒症）的一种有前景的策略。方法：我们采用结合机器学习分类和分子对接的计算流程，识别NLRP3、IKBKB、JAK1、CCR5和SIGMAR1的多靶点调节剂。为消除数据泄漏，特征选择严格嵌入10折交叉验证循环中。我们对候选物进行结构评估，分析其结合亲和力和活性位点接触残基。结果：模型在五种蛋白上的准确率达到95.0%至99.6%，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.995至1.000，显示出稳健的泛化能力。我们发现了多个在五种蛋白上的模型预测平均得分均高于0.50的化合物。对接分析证实，排名靠前的候选物具有有利的结合能，其结合亲和力强于已知蛋白抑制剂。具体而言，Simeprevir的平均对接评分为-10.3 kcal/mol。候选药物之间共享的关键接触残基进一步支持这些对接评分的有效性，并提示值得开展有意义的体外研究。结论：单药多靶点抑制能够有效调节驱动脓毒症相关细胞因子风暴的相互连接的炎症回路。该方法为重症监护医学中的多药联合治疗提供了替代方案。
items.author_line: Leo Meng, Valentina L. Kouznetsova, Santosh Kesari, Igor F. Tsigelny

items.title: In situ monitoring of solvent dependent CsPbBr3 nanorod growth from lead halide precursors
items.abstract_or_text: CsPbBr 3 nanocrystals are promising semiconductors for numerous optoelectronic applications due to their high quantum yield and impressive tunability. Most recently, one-dimensional perovskite nanorods and nanowires have attracted attention for their advanced luminescence properties such as light polarization and lasing. Such applications require precise morphological and surface chemistry control, both of which are difficult to obtain using conventional synthesis pathways. A novel approach is to use preformed lead halide clusters as nucleation sites, decoupling nucleation and growth to lower dispersity. In this work, we utilize preformed PbBr 2 clusters in 1-octadecene as precursors for anisotropic growth of CsPbBr 3 nanorods. Using in situ UV-Vis absorbance and photoluminescence spectroscopies, we monitored the different morphologies and phases formed during the growth of CsPbBr 3 . We investigate the impact of the solvent on precursor chemistry, final nanorod structure, as well as the growth pathway to reach those structures. Our results show that for growth occurring in toluene, the lead halide precursors are isolated octahedra favoring a classical diffusion mechanism and nanorods with less defined width. When the reaction occurs in 1-octadecene, the precursors form preassembled monolayers, promoting oriented assembly and giving rise to distinct, coexisting, two and three monolayer thick nanorods. Sequential crystallization of Cs 4 PbBr 6 was observed in toluene because of the increasing ligand concentration during nanorod growth. Cs 4 PbBr 6 crystals could then be converted into two monolayer thick nanorods through the addition of a small volume of ethanol. These results shed light on the importance of solvent choice on lead precursor chemistry to obtain homogeneous size-controlled nanorods.
items.summary_zh: 利用原位UV-Vis吸收和光致发光光谱监测PbBr2前驱体在不同溶剂中生成CsPbBr3纳米棒的过程，揭示甲苯与1-octadecene中前驱体组装方式、形貌和相变路径的差异。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将前驱体化学、溶剂选择与钙钛矿纳米棒尺寸和层数控制联系起来，并观察到Cs4PbBr6向双层纳米棒的转化，为可控合成和光电材料设计提供机制线索。结果仍集中于特定前驱体和溶剂体系，外推到其他合成条件需谨慎。
items.abstract_zh: CsPbBr3纳米晶是很有前景的半导体，可用于众多光电应用，因为它们具有高量子产率和出色的可调性。最近，一维钙钛矿纳米棒和纳米线因其先进的发光性质（如偏振发光和激光）而受到关注。这些应用需要精确控制形貌和表面化学，而使用传统合成路径很难实现。一个新方法是使用预先形成的卤化铅团簇作为成核位点，从而解耦成核和生长并降低分散性。在本研究中，我们使用1-octadecene中的预先形成PbBr2团簇作为前驱体，促进CsPbBr3纳米棒的各向异性生长。我们使用原位UV-Vis吸收和光致发光光谱，监测CsPbBr3生长过程中形成的不同形貌和相。我们研究了溶剂对前驱体化学、最终纳米棒结构以及达到这些结构的生长路径的影响。结果显示，在甲苯中生长时，卤化铅前驱体是分离的八面体，倾向于经典扩散机制，并形成宽度定义较差的纳米棒。当反应在1-octadecene中进行时，前驱体形成预组装单层，促进定向组装，并产生明显共存的双层和三层纳米棒。在甲苯中，由于纳米棒生长过程中配体浓度增加，观察到Cs4PbBr6的顺序结晶。随后，通过加入少量乙醇，可以将Cs4PbBr6晶体转化为双层纳米棒。这些结果揭示了溶剂选择对铅前驱体化学的重要性，有助于获得均一且尺寸受控的纳米棒。
items.author_line: Adrien Donatini, Maia Simpson-Russell, Marek Majewski

items.title: QMzyme: A Python Package for Automated and Systematic QM-based Enzyme Modeling
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce QMzyme, a Python package to automate the generation of Quantum mechanics (QM)-based enzyme models. QM calculations on enzymes are computationally challenging because full enzyme systems typically contain thousands of atoms, placing accurate QM treatments beyond practical computational limits.Therefore, QM-based enzyme studies rely on identifying a subset of atoms that captures the essential chemistry of the reaction environment, enabling tractable yet chemically meaningful calculations. However, constructing these reduced models requires numerous user-defined decisions, including selection of the starting structure, identification of atoms to include in the QM region, and definition of truncation strategies for QM-only models, all of which can substantially influence the resulting calculations. QMzyme aims to provide the community with a flexible and extensible framework for automated, systematic generation of QM-based enzyme models, enabling researchers to more rigorously evaluate how model construction decisions influence computational outcomes while improving reproducibility and transparency across workflows. By facilitating high-throughput generation and analysis of QM enzyme models, QMzyme supports largescale, data-driven investigations of enzyme structure, function, and reactivity. This effort is especially crucial for the creation of large, chemically consistent datasets that can support emergent artificial intelligence and machine learning approaches for accelerated digital discovery in enzymology and biocatalysis.
items.summary_zh: 介绍QMzyme Python软件包，自动化生成量子力学（QM）酶模型，使研究者能够系统评估起始结构、QM区域和截断策略等建模选择对计算结果的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把酶QM建模中大量依赖人工的决策转化为可复现、可批量分析的流程，有助于建立化学一致的大型数据集并支持酶催化机器学习。摘要主要描述框架目标，尚未给出与现有工具的定量性能比较。
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍QMzyme，一个用于自动化生成基于量子力学（QM）的酶模型的Python软件包。酶上的QM计算在计算上具有挑战性，因为完整的酶体系通常包含数千个原子，使得精确的QM处理超出实际可行的计算限制。因此，基于QM的酶研究依赖于识别一个原子子集，该子集能够捕捉反应环境中的关键化学，同时使计算保持可处理且具有化学意义。然而，构建这些缩减模型需要用户作出许多决定，包括选择起始结构、确定要纳入QM区域的原子，以及定义仅用于QM模型的截断策略；这些决定都可能显著影响计算结果。QMzyme旨在提供一个灵活且可扩展的框架，用于自动化、系统地生成基于QM的酶模型，使研究者能够更严格地评估模型构建决策如何影响计算结果，同时提高工作流的可复现性和透明度。通过促进QM酶模型的高通量生成与分析，QMzyme支持对酶结构、功能和反应性的高规模数据驱动研究。这项工作对于创建大型且化学一致的数据集尤其重要，这些数据集可以支持新兴的人工智能和机器学习方法，加速酶学和生物催化中的数字化发现。
items.author_line: Arkanil Roy, Young Woo Kim, Heidi Klem

items.title: HMVA-DDI: A Hierarchical Multi-View Attention Network for Drug-Drug Interaction and Severity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Background and Objective: Prescribing multiple drugs simultaneously, known as polypharmacy, is increasingly common in managing chronic diseases such as diabetes and cardiovascular conditions. Studies show that roughly 40% of elderly patients are on five or more medications, putting them at significant risk of adverse drug-drug interactions (DDIs) [1]. While computational methods based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown strong potential for predicting these interactions from a drugs molecular structure, most existing models are limited in two important ways: they rely on attention mechanisms that cannot adapt to the unique context of each atom in a molecule, and they only predict whether an interaction exists rather than how dangerous it might be. Methods: We propose HMVA-DDI, a two-stage deep learning framework that addresses both shortcomings. In the first stage, our model predicts whether two drugs will interact. If it detects an interaction, the second stage classifies it into one of three clinical severity levels: minor, moderate, or major. To better capture molecular structure, we replace the standard attention mechanism with a more powerful version called Graph Attention Network v2 (GATv2), which considers each atoms specific context when learning its representation. We also introduce a technique to prevent information loss in deeper network layers, and we tailor the input features separately for each prediction task. Results: Evaluated on two standard benchmarks, DrugBank 5.0.3 [2] and DDInter [3], HMVA-DDI achieves an AUROC of 0.9819 and AUPRC of 0.9759 on binary interaction detection, a marked improvement over the baseline. For severity classification, our best model variant (qcSvr4) reaches an overall AUROC of 0.9444, with a particularly large improvement in detecting low-severity (Minor) interactions, a historically difficult class. Conclusion: HMVA-DDI bridges the gap between computational drug research and clinical usefulness by not only predicting interactions accurately but also indicating interaction severity. This two-level system can help healthcare professionals prioritize warnings, reducing the alert fatigue problem where doctors are overwhelmed by too many non-critical notifications.
items.summary_zh: 提出HMVA-DDI两阶段模型，先预测药物相互作用，再将其分为minor、moderate和major三个临床严重程度等级；使用GATv2和任务定制输入，在DrugBank 5.0.3与DDInter基准上取得较高AUROC和AUPRC。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 从单纯判断是否存在DDI推进到预测严重程度，有望帮助临床优先处理警报并减少alert fatigue。结果仍基于公开基准数据，尚未进行前瞻性临床验证，且严重程度标签质量会直接影响实际可用性。
items.abstract_zh: 背景与目标：同时开具多种药物，即多重用药，在糖尿病和心血管疾病等慢性病管理中越来越常见。研究表明，约40%的老年患者使用五种或更多药物，使其面临不良药物—药物相互作用（DDI）的显著风险。基于图神经网络（GNN）的计算方法已经显示出从药物分子结构预测这些相互作用的巨大潜力，但现有大多数模型在两个重要方面受到限制：它们依赖无法适应分子中每个原子独特上下文的注意力机制，并且只能预测是否存在相互作用，而不能预测其危险程度。方法：我们提出HMVA-DDI，一个两阶段深度学习框架，用于解决这两个缺陷。第一阶段，模型预测两种药物是否会发生相互作用。如果检测到相互作用，第二阶段会将其分为minor、moderate或major三个临床严重程度等级。为了更好地捕捉分子结构，我们用更强大的Graph Attention Network v2（GATv2）替代标准注意力机制，使模型在学习表示时考虑每个原子的特定上下文。我们还引入了一种防止深层网络层信息丢失的技术，并为每个预测任务分别定制输入特征。结果：在两个标准基准DrugBank 5.0.3和DDInter上评估时，HMVA-DDI在二元相互作用检测中达到AUROC 0.9819和AUPRC 0.9759，相比基线有明显提升。在严重程度分类中，最佳模型变体qcSvr4达到总体AUROC 0.9444，在历史上较难识别的低严重程度（Minor）类别上取得了尤其大的提升。结论：HMVA-DDI不仅能准确预测相互作用，还能指示相互作用严重程度，从而弥合计算药物研究与临床实用性之间的差距。这种两级系统可以帮助医疗专业人员优先处理警报，减少alert fatigue问题，即医生被过多非关键通知淹没的情况。
items.author_line: Hati, B., Bhat, R., Kudari, Z. D., Kaira, V. S., P, S. S., Gnana Sekaran, J.

items.title: Probing the sequence variability tolerance in a de novo α-helical barrel biocatalyst
items.abstract_or_text: De novo-designed enzymes have recently achieved high catalytic activity and stereoselectivity while demonstrating exceptional thermostability in entirely novel protein scaffolds. Among these, -helical barrel protein scaffolds are attractive structures for biocatalysis due to their structural simplicity, high thermostability, and rationalizable sequence patterning. However, enabling major structural reengineering of these scaffolds while maintaining the structure, stability and catalytic activity while also improving soluble protein production remain major challenges and pose the fundamental question how engineerable a de novo backbone-sequence pair is. Here, we combine deep learning based and classic computational protein design to modify and optimize de novo -helical barrel biocatalysts. Using the previously reported six-helical barrel 6H5L as a model scaffold, AlphaFold2-guided RosettaRemodel enabled the design of a truncated variant, whose crystal structure closely matches the design model. Additional sequence-redesign using ProteinMPNN generated a variant with a tenfold increase of soluble protein yield in Escherichia coli. Biochemical, biophysical, and structural analyses showed that both variants retained the overall barrel architecture, high thermal stability, and catalytic activity for both purified protein and whole-cell systems. Detailed kinetic analysis on the variants showed both variation in kcat and Km, reflecting changes in catalytic turnover and substrate binding. Together, these approaches provide new insights and possibilities for the further engineering of functional de novo -helical barrels, their ability to withstand dramatically large sequence changes and their broader application in biocatalysis and biotechnology.
items.summary_zh: 结合AlphaFold2引导的RosettaRemodel和ProteinMPNN重设计de novo α-helical barrel生物催化剂；截短变体的晶体结构接近设计模型，另一变体在大肠杆菌中的可溶蛋白产量提高10倍，同时保留桶状结构、热稳定性和催化活性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了计算蛋白设计大幅改造新型酶骨架仍能保留功能的实验案例，并同时改善可溶表达。研究只涉及一个6H5L模型骨架和有限变体，活性与稳定性的适用范围仍需扩展验证。
items.abstract_zh: 近期，de novo设计的酶已经在完全新颖的蛋白质支架中实现了高催化活性和立体选择性，同时表现出卓越的热稳定性。其中，α-helical barrel蛋白支架因其结构简单、热稳定性高以及序列模式可理性化而对生物催化具有吸引力。然而，在保持结构、稳定性和催化活性的同时对这些支架进行大规模结构重设计，并进一步提高可溶蛋白产量，仍然是重大挑战，也提出了一个基本问题：一个de novo骨架—序列配对究竟具有多大的可工程化程度。在此，我们结合基于深度学习的方法和经典计算蛋白设计来改造和优化de novo α-helical barrel生物催化剂。我们以此前报道的六螺旋桶6H5L作为模型支架，AlphaFold2引导的RosettaRemodel实现了一个截短变体的设计，其晶体结构与设计模型高度吻合。随后使用ProteinMPNN进行序列重设计，生成了一个在Escherichia coli中可溶蛋白产量提高10倍的变体。生化、生物物理和结构分析表明，这两个变体都保留了整体桶状结构、高热稳定性以及在纯化蛋白和全细胞体系中的催化活性。对这些变体的详细动力学分析显示，kcat和Km均发生了变化，反映出催化周转和底物结合的改变。总体而言，这些方法为进一步工程化具有功能的de novo α-helical barrel、理解其承受大幅序列变化的能力以及拓展其在生物催化和生物技术中的应用提供了新的认识和可能性。
items.author_line: Elaily, W., Braun, M., Stoll, D., Chakatok, M., Aleotti, M., Grill, B., Bijelic, A., Hall, M., Oberdorfer, G.

items.title: ROSE: a Foundation Model for Reusable One-dimensional Spectrum Embeddings in 1H NMR
items.abstract_or_text: Most deep learning models for 1H NMR are trained for a single endpoint and do not provide representations that can be reused across analytical tasks. We introduce ROSE (Reusable One-dimensional Spectrum Embeddings), a 7.8-million-parameter spectrum-side foundation model pretrained on 3.2 million experimental and simulated spectra using an InChIKey-14 identity holdout that excludes all molecules appearing in the external benchmark test sets. Its shared spectral encoder supports denoising, peak detection, classification, cross-field alignment, molecular retrieval and structure-tospectrum prediction. Beyond internal evaluation on identity-disjoint holdouts, ROSE was assessed on external benchmarks excluded from pretraining, matching the published QIB PLS-DA result for 60-MHz edible-oil classification (98.8% balanced accuracy vs 98.9% accuracy), reducing NMRNet structure-to-spectrum Chamfer loss by 39% over Morgan+Ridge (0.79 vs 1.29), achieving 69% peak-detection F1 on NMRformer, and, after short domain adaptation, reaching 37.1% Top-1 and 67.7% Top-10 retrieval on NMR-Solver. ROSE represents a first step toward a general-purpose NMR foundation model for scalable industrial analytical applications.
items.summary_zh: 提出ROSE，一个在3.2 million条实验和模拟1H NMR谱上预训练的7.8-million-parameter谱图基础模型，支持去噪、峰检测、分类、跨场强对齐、分子检索和谱图—结构转换，并在多个外部基准上测试。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为1H NMR分析提供可复用的谱图表示，外部基准上接近或超过专用方法，具有工业分析扩展潜力。需要注意其部分结果依赖短期领域适配，且预训练身份留出策略和不同仪器条件下的稳健性仍需持续验证。
items.abstract_zh: 大多数用于1H NMR的深度学习模型都针对单一终点进行训练，无法提供可复用于多个分析任务的表示。我们提出ROSE（Reusable One-dimensional Spectrum Embeddings），一个包含7.8-million参数、谱图侧的基础模型，在3.2 million条实验和模拟谱图上进行预训练，并采用InChIKey-14身份留出策略，排除了外部基准测试集中出现的所有分子。其共享谱图编码器支持去噪、峰检测、分类、跨场强对齐、分子检索以及结构到谱图的预测。除在身份不重叠的内部留出集上进行评估外，ROSE还在预训练中排除的外部基准上进行测试：在60-MHz食用油分类任务中，其结果与已发表的QIB PLS-DA结果相当（平衡准确率98.8%，对方准确率98.9%）；在NMRformer上，将NMRNet结构到谱图的Chamfer loss相对于Morgan+Ridge降低39%（0.79对1.29）；在NMRformer峰检测上达到69%的F1；经过短期领域适配后，在NMR-Solver分子检索上达到37.1%的Top-1和67.7%的Top-10。ROSE代表了通用NMR基础模型的第一步，可用于可扩展的工业分析应用。

items.title: Fusion2AI: functional re-annotation of the bacterial transparent matter proteins
items.abstract_or_text: Determining the biological function of bacterial proteins remains a central challenge in microbiology. We previously developed Fusion, a reference-free scheme that clustered the tens of millions of known, unique, bacterial proteins into about four hundred thousand groups of functionally similar proteins, i.e. functions. For any newly identified proteins, Fusion function assignment could be performed using function-aware sequence alignment to each function's representatives. However, Fusion functions lack human-readable descriptions of their functionality. Here, we leverage large language models (LLMs) to synthesize scattered, partial annotations of functions of individual proteins into coherent English-language descriptions for ~100,000 clusters, i.e. a quarter of all Fusion functions. From these descriptions, we extract Gene Ontology (GO) terms and Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers. We validate these against annotations inferred from UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot. These annotations immediately expand functional coverage for both genome and microbiome -level analyses. For organisms in FusionDB, we annotate 50% more proteins than alignment to Swiss-Prot alone. For other bacteria, the gain is smaller but still reaches 30% for some organisms. For microbiomes, annotation coverage increases nearly ten-fold. Our work thus enables the analysis of microbial "transparent matter," i.e. functions already described in earlier research that have not yet made it into usable annotations. Our annotated Fusion function database is freely available at https://services.bromberglab.org/fusion2ai and as a reference DB for metagenome annotation https://services.bromberglab.org/mifaser.
items.summary_zh: 利用LLM把Fusion功能簇中的零散蛋白注释汇总为约100,000个可读描述，并提取GO术语和EC编号；与UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot推断注释对照后，显著扩大基因组和微生物组的功能覆盖。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 解决大量已知但缺乏可用人类可读注释的细菌蛋白功能空白，尤其使微生物组注释覆盖率接近提高10倍。LLM生成注释仍可能继承原始注释错误，且摘要未给出逐条人工或实验功能验证。
items.abstract_zh: 确定细菌蛋白质的生物学功能仍然是微生物学中的核心挑战。我们此前开发了Fusion，这是一种无参考方案，将数千万个已知的、独特的细菌蛋白聚类成约四十万个功能相似的蛋白组，即功能。对于任何新发现的蛋白质，都可以使用面向功能的序列比对，将其分配到各功能代表中。然而，Fusion功能缺少人类可读的功能描述。在此，我们利用大语言模型（LLM），将单个蛋白质的零散、部分注释综合为连贯的英文描述，覆盖约100,000个簇，即全部Fusion功能的四分之一。我们从这些描述中提取Gene Ontology（GO）术语和Enzyme Commission（EC）编号，并将其与根据UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot推断的注释进行验证。这些注释立即扩大了基因组和微生物组层面的功能覆盖。对于FusionDB中的生物体，与仅通过Swiss-Prot比对相比，我们多注释了50%的蛋白质。对于其他细菌，增益较小，但对某些生物体仍达到30%；对于微生物组，注释覆盖率接近提高10倍。因此，我们的工作使对微生物“透明物质”的分析成为可能，即那些已经在早期研究中描述、但尚未进入可用注释的功能。我们标注的Fusion功能数据库可免费在https://services.bromberglab.org/fusion2ai获取，也可作为宏基因组注释的参考数据库，地址为https://services.bromberglab.org/mifaser。

items.title: Assessing chemical toxicity across Eukaryota using multimodal transformers
items.abstract_or_text: Biodiversity is globally threatened by chemical pollution, yet toxicity data remain unavailable for millions of species and tens of thousands of chemicals, severely limiting our ability to assess ecological impacts. Here we present TRIDENT-2, a multimodal artificial intelligence model for predicting chemical toxicity across evolutionarily diverse eukaryotic species. Trained on 560,780 toxicity assays spanning 82,775 chemicals, 6,793 species, and multiple exposure scenarios, TRIDENT-2 accurately predicts toxicity across Eukaryota with an average median absolute error ranging from 1.76 to 3.80. By jointly learning from chemical, biological, and experimental information, it remains accurate across broad chemical and taxonomic distances, allowing for toxicity assessment for species and chemicals beyond the current experimental evidence. Our findings demonstrate that artificial intelligence can help overcome longstanding data limitations in ecotoxicology, paving the way for improved decision-making and reducing chemical impacts on biodiversity and ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 提出TRIDENT-2多模态模型，联合化学、物种生物学和实验信息，在560,780条毒性测定、82,775种化学品和6,793个物种上训练，以预测跨真核生物的化学毒性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对生态毒理学中物种和化学品数据稀缺问题，模型在广泛化学和分类距离外仍保持一定精度，可支持实验优先级和生态风险评估。其跨物种外推仍可能受训练数据偏倚影响，摘要未说明独立野外或实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 生物多样性正受到化学污染的全球性威胁，但数百万个物种和数万种化学品的毒性数据仍然不可获得，严重限制了我们评估生态影响的能力。在此，我们提出TRIDENT-2，一个用于预测跨演化多样真核物种化学毒性的多模态人工智能模型。该模型在560,780条毒性测定数据上训练，覆盖82,775种化学品、6,793个物种和多种暴露情景。TRIDENT-2能够准确预测跨真核生物的毒性，平均中位绝对误差范围为1.76至3.80。通过联合学习化学、生物学和实验信息，它在广泛的化学距离和分类距离下仍保持准确性，从而可以评估当前实验数据之外的物种和化学品的毒性。我们的研究表明，人工智能可以帮助克服生态毒理学长期存在的数据限制，促进更好的决策，并减少化学品对生物多样性和生态系统的影响。

items.title: Effect of an Electronic Health Record-Integrated Clinical Dashboard for Radiologists on STAT Priority Chest Radiograph Reporting and Downstream Care: A Stepped-Wedge Cluster Randomized Trial
items.abstract_or_text: Background. Chest radiographs (CXRs) are the most common imaging exam performed, but CXR reports can be nonspecific due to incomplete history, relying on vague terms like opacities to convey diagnostic uncertainty. We prospectively evaluated whether introducing a clinical dashboard with relevant patient information affects CXR report specificity and efficiency, report concordance with discharge diagnoses, and follow-up chest CT utilization. Methods. In this stepped-wedge cluster randomized trial (NCT06785246), a clinical dashboard for radiologists was rolled out with user education sessions across 15 service areas of an integrated health system from June 2024 to June 2025. Emergency department (ED) and inpatient CXRs were included. A large language model (GPT-4o) was validated using a Delphi panel of three experts to classify report specificity and CXR report diagnosis. A subsequent model release (GPT-5.4) graded each CXR report impression as negative, specific abnormal, or nonspecific abnormal. It also judged whether an abnormal impression matched an ED discharge diagnosis. The primary outcome was the proportion of specific reports (negative or specific abnormal). Secondary outcomes were report-discharge diagnosis concordance, follow-up chest CT, antibiotic and diuretic orders, and CXR reporting time. Mixed-effects models adjusted for time, patient age, and radiograph view, with random effects for radiologists, facilities, and service area. Results. The trial included 404,860 ED and inpatient encounter STAT priority CXRs read by 387 radiologists (256,303 control; 148,557 intervention). The adjusted proportion of specific reports was 82.2% in control periods and 82.1% in intervention periods (difference, -0.10 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.53 to 0.34; P=.66). Among abnormal reports, concordance with a discharge diagnosis rose from 40.9% to 42.2% (difference, 1.24 points; 95% CI, 0.20 to 2.28; P=.02). Follow-up chest CT fell from 11.4% to 10.9% (difference, -0.55 points; 95% CI, -0.92 to -0.17; P=.004). Antibiotic orders (24.0% vs 23.9%) and diuretic orders (14.7% vs 14.8%) within 7 days did not change, nor did reporting time (difference, -0.8 seconds; 95% CI, -2.7 to 1.0). Conclusions. Giving radiologists EHR context through a dashboard did not change the specificity of STAT priority CXR reports or prescribing patterns. It was associated with small improvements in diagnostic concordance and follow-up CT use, without slowing reporting. Validated large language models make it feasible to measure report quality across a health system.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；随机试验】在 15 个服务区域、387 名放射科医师和 404,860 次急诊及住院 STAT 胸片检查中，评估接入 EHR 信息的临床仪表板。仪表板未改变报告特异性或处方，但与轻度提高的出院诊断一致性和减少随访胸部 CT 相关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模 stepped-wedge cluster randomized trial 提供了真实临床工作流中的实施证据，结果同时显示了干预效果的边界，避免把相关性解读为广泛临床获益。
items.abstract_zh: 背景。胸部 X 线片（CXR）是最常进行的影像学检查，但由于病史不完整，CXR 报告可能缺乏特异性，依赖 opacities 等模糊术语表达诊断不确定性。我们前瞻性评估了引入包含相关患者信息的临床仪表板是否影响 CXR 报告的特异性和效率、报告与出院诊断的一致性，以及后续胸部 CT 的使用。方法。在这项阶梯楔形集群随机试验（NCT06785246）中，临床仪表板配合用户教育，于 2024 年 6 月至 2025 年 6 月在一个整合医疗系统的 15 个服务区域逐步上线。研究纳入急诊科（ED）和住院 CXR。研究使用经 3 名专家 Delphi 小组验证的大语言模型（GPT-4o）对报告特异性和 CXR 报告诊断进行分类。随后发布的模型（GPT-5.4）将每份 CXR 报告印象分为阴性、特异性异常或非特异性异常，并判断异常印象是否与 ED 出院诊断相符。主要结局是特异性报告（阴性或特异性异常）的比例。次要结局包括报告与出院诊断的一致性、后续胸部 CT、抗生素和利尿剂医嘱，以及 CXR 报告时间。混合效应模型针对时间、患者年龄和 X 线片视图进行调整，并将放射科医师、医疗机构和服务区域作为随机效应。结果。试验包括 404,860 次由 387 名放射科医师阅片的 ED 和住院 STAT 优先 CXR 检查（对照期 256,303 次；干预期 148,557 次）。调整后的特异性报告比例在对照期为 82.2%，在干预期为 82.1%（差异 -0.10 个百分点；95% CI，-0.53 至 0.34；P=.66）。在异常报告中，与出院诊断的一致性由 40.9% 升至 42.2%（差异 1.24 个百分点；95% CI，0.20 至 2.28；P=.02）。后续胸部 CT 由 11.4% 降至 10.9%（差异 -0.55 个百分点；95% CI，-0.92 至 -0.17；P=.004）。7 天内抗生素医嘱（24.0% 对 23.9%）和利尿剂医嘱（14.7% 对 14.8%）均未改变，报告时间也未改变（差异 -0.8 秒；95% CI，-2.7 至 1.0）。结论。通过仪表板向放射科医师提供 EHR 背景信息，并未改变 STAT 优先 CXR 报告的特异性或处方模式，但与诊断一致性的小幅改善和后续 CT 使用减少相关，且未延长报告时间。经验证的大语言模型使在整个医疗系统范围内测量报告质量成为可能。

items.title: Single-cell profiling resolves gain- and loss-of-function mechanisms in CASR to advance mechanism-aware variant classification
items.abstract_or_text: Multiplexed assays of variant effect (MAVEs) and computational methods have advanced variant classification but have struggled to distinguish the molecular mechanism of variants with sufficient accuracy, limiting utility for multi-mechanism genes. Here, we coupled single-cell RNA-seq profiling with supervised machine learning to predict the mechanism of variants in CASR, a gene in which gain of function (GOF) variants cause hypocalcemia and loss of function (LOF) variants cause hypercalcemia. We engineered endogenous CASR-depleted HEK293 cells to express a single exogenous variant copy, measured their transcriptional profiles at single-cell resolution, trained a multi-class machine learning model on 96 expert-annotated variants (25 benign, 35 LOF, 36 GOF), and predicted mechanism for 157 variants of uncertain significance, of which 16 were predicted GOF and 54 LOF. The model showed high performance (macro F1 0.98, overall accuracy 0.98), and its predictions were corroborated by clinical phenotype and serum calcium measurements across more than 300,000 patients in a commercial genetic testing database. These results highlight the effectiveness of using molecular mechanism annotations with scRNA-seq to train models that distinguish molecular mechanisms of pathogenicity. The approach has immediate relevance for clinical variant classification and establishes a foundation for mechanism-guided clinical management in disorders with mechanism-dependent interventions, with potential application to other multi-mechanism genes.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；临床验证】研究将单细胞 RNA-seq 与监督式机器学习结合，区分 CASR 变异的 gain-of-function（GOF）和 loss-of-function（LOF）机制；在 96 个专家标注变异上训练，并对 157 个意义未明变异分类，预测结果与超过 300,000 名患者的临床表型和血钙数据相互印证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把变异效应的单细胞分子机制信息连接到临床变异分类，展示了机制感知模型的潜在实用性，但仍属于预印本证据。
items.abstract_zh: 多重变异效应测定（MAVEs）和计算方法推动了变异分类，但在足够准确地区分分子机制方面仍存在困难，限制了其对具有多种机制基因的应用。在本研究中，我们将单细胞 RNA-seq 分析与监督式机器学习结合，用于预测 CASR 中变异的机制；该基因的 gain of function（GOF）变异会导致低钙血症，而 loss of function（LOF）变异会导致高钙血症。我们构建了内源性 CASR 被耗竭的 HEK293 细胞，使其表达单个外源变异拷贝，在单细胞分辨率下测量转录组，利用 96 个专家标注变异（25 个良性、35 个 LOF、36 个 GOF）训练多分类机器学习模型，并对 157 个意义未明变异预测其机制，其中 16 个被预测为 GOF，54 个被预测为 LOF。该模型表现出较高性能（宏平均 F1 为 0.98，总体准确率为 0.98），其预测结果得到商业遗传检测数据库中超过 300,000 名患者的临床表型和血清钙测量结果支持。这些结果凸显了利用带有分子机制注释的 scRNA-seq 训练模型、区分致病机制的有效性。该方法与临床变异分类直接相关，并为机制导向的临床管理建立了基础，也可能适用于其他具有多种机制的基因。

items.title: Multi-Model Machine Learning Consensus Identifies a Dual-Interferon Gene Signature in Ischemic Stroke: An Integrative Single-Cell Transcriptomic Analysis
items.abstract_or_text: An Ischemic stroke is one of the main causes of death and long-term disability around the world. There are very few treatment options available, especially for the cases where the short time period to give clot dissolving medicine has passed (Powers et al., 2019). While single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) has emerged as a powerful tool for understanding cell-to-cell differences within at issue (cellular heterogeneity) (Tang et al., 2009). However translating these high dimensional datasets into clinically useful biomarkers remains challenging (Rajko-mar et al., 2019). A major problem with current biomarker studies is their reliance on a single machine learning model, where results may reflect model bias rather than true biological signals (Lopez-Rincon et al., 2020). Methods: We developed a multi-model consensus framework integrating eight different machine learning methods from three groups: traditional models (logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost), a hybrid deep learning model (CNN-XGBoost), and transformer-inspired models (scGPT, scBERT, sc-Former, Geneformer). The proposed framework was applied to scRNA-seq data from a mouse middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO) model (GSE174574; n=6 mice, 54,599 cells). To prevent data leakage, we implemented rigorous subject-wise train/test splitting, ensuring all cells from individual animals remained either in the training sets or in the testsets. Results: All eight models achieved excellent performance on the independent test data, with AUC scores between 0.9778 and 0.9975. From six models that allowed gene level importance extraction, we identified 63 consensus genes (threshold: [≥] 4/6 models), with 17 genes selected by all 6 models. Pathway enrichment analysis showed significant enrichment of interferon signaling, with a novel dual-interferon pattern. Twelve of the consensus genes respond to interferon, and five of them (Ifitm6, Ifitm1, Gbp2, Igtp, Tgtp1) respond to both Type I (IFN-/{beta}) and Type II (IFN-{gamma}) interferons. Notably the consensus included Il1rn (interleukin-1 receptor antagonist), the target of Anakinra -- an FDA-approved drug that has completed Phase II stroke trials with promising safety profiles (Smith et al., 2018; Emsley et al., 2005). Conclusions: The Multi-model consensus framework, proposed in this paper, provides a robust and reliable approach to biomarker discovery that goes beyond the limitations of any single method and reduces individual algorithm bias. The convergence of classical, ensemble, and deep learning methods on interferon and IL-1 pathway genes supports their biological validity as stroke biomarkers. Our findings provide a prioritized gene list for further clinical validation and highlight interferon signaling as a possible treatment strategy warranting further investigation. Keywords: ischemic stroke; machine learning; single-cell RNA sequencing; biomarker discovery; consensus analysis; interferon signaling; neuroinflammation
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；动物单细胞数据】在小鼠 MCAO 模型的 54,599 个细胞上，比较 8 类机器学习模型并采用按个体划分的训练/测试集，得到 63 个共识基因和双干扰素信号模式；结果提出了卒中生物标志物候选，但尚需临床验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多模型共识与严格防数据泄漏设计降低了单一算法偏差，且数据规模和独立测试性能较强；不过证据来自小鼠模型，不能直接推出人类治疗因果关系。
items.abstract_zh: 缺血性卒中是全球死亡和长期残疾的主要原因之一。可用的治疗选择很少，尤其是在给予溶栓药物的短时间窗已经过去的病例中。虽然单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）已成为理解组织内细胞间差异（细胞异质性）的强大工具，但将这些高维数据转化为具有临床用途的生物标志物仍然具有挑战性。当前生物标志物研究的一个主要问题是依赖单一机器学习模型，其结果可能反映模型偏差，而不是真实的生物学信号。方法：我们建立了一个多模型共识框架，整合来自 3 组的 8 种机器学习方法：传统模型（logistic regression、random forest、XGBoost）、混合深度学习模型（CNN-XGBoost）以及受 transformer 启发的模型（scGPT、scBERT、sc-Former、Geneformer）。该框架应用于小鼠大脑中动脉阻塞（MCAO）模型的 scRNA-seq 数据（GSE174574；n=6 只小鼠，54,599 个细胞）。为防止数据泄漏，我们实施了严格的按个体划分训练集和测试集，确保同一动物的所有细胞全部位于训练集或测试集之一。结果：8 个模型在独立测试数据上均取得很高性能，AUC 为 0.9778 至 0.9975。在允许提取基因层面重要性的 6 个模型中，我们鉴定出 63 个共识基因（阈值：[≥] 4/6 个模型），其中 17 个基因被全部 6 个模型选中。通路富集分析显示干扰素信号显著富集，呈现出一种新的双干扰素模式。共识基因中有 12 个对干扰素产生响应，其中 5 个（Ifitm6、Ifitm1、Gbp2、Igtp、Tgtp1）同时响应 I 型（IFN-/{beta}）和 II 型（IFN-{gamma}）干扰素。值得注意的是，共识基因包括 Il1rn（白细胞介素-1 受体拮抗剂），其靶点是 Anakinra；Anakinra 是一种 FDA 批准药物，已完成卒中 II 期试验，并显示出令人鼓舞的安全性。结论：本文提出的多模型共识框架提供了一种稳健可靠的生物标志物发现方法，超越了单一方法的局限，并减少了单个算法的偏差。经典模型、集成模型和深度学习模型均汇聚到干扰素和 IL-1 通路基因，这支持这些基因作为卒中生物标志物的生物学有效性。我们的结果提供了一个可供进一步临床验证的优先基因列表，并提示干扰素信号可能是一种值得进一步研究的治疗策略。关键词：缺血性卒中；机器学习；单细胞 RNA 测序；生物标志物发现；共识分析；干扰素信号；神经炎症

items.title: Baseline immune transcriptional signatures predict checkpoint blockade response in triple-negative breast cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Immune checkpoint inhibitors improve clinical outcomes in a subset of patients with triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), but biomarkers that identify likely responders before treatment remain limited. We asked whether baseline transcriptional profiles from different immune-cell compartments contain multigene information associated with treatment response. We analyzed pre-treatment single-cell RNA sequencing data from 45 patients with TNBC and generated patient-level profiles for T cells, B cells, myeloid cells, and an integrated immune compartment. Random Forest feature selection identified response-associated signatures that were evaluated using logistic regression, feedforward neural networks, and support vector machines. The integrated immune signature showed the strongest development-cohort performance, reaching an accuracy of 0.8936 and an AUC of 0.9335 with support vector machine classification. RF-selected genes were enriched for nominal response-associated expression differences, although no individual gene remained significant after false-discovery-rate correction. CAMERA analysis showed higher interferon-alpha response in responders across all four immune profiles, whereas several metabolic and stress-related Hallmark signatures were higher in non-responders in T-cell and integrated profiles. These functional differences were only partially represented among RF-selected genes. Several reanalyzed T-cell RF features also showed nominal associations with overall survival in TNBC. %red{} Evaluation in an independent nine-patient TNBC cohort showed heterogeneous performance across immune profiles and classifiers, with discordance between threshold-dependent metrics and AUC in several models. Together, these findings show that baseline immune transcriptional profiles contain multigene information associated with checkpoint-blockade response in TNBC and that integrating T-cell, B-cell, and myeloid transcriptional information improves response discrimination.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；患者队列】利用 45 名 TNBC 患者的治疗前单细胞 RNA 测序数据构建 T 细胞、B 细胞、髓系细胞及整合免疫特征；整合特征在开发队列中达到 AUC 0.9335，但独立 9 人队列表现异质，不能视为已验证的预测因果标志物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把多个免疫细胞区室整合到患者级预测中，并报告了外部验证中的性能不一致，为免疫检查点阻断反应标志物的评估提供了较为谨慎的证据。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 免疫检查点抑制剂可改善一部分三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）患者的临床结局，但用于治疗前识别可能应答者的生物标志物仍然有限。我们考察了不同免疫细胞区室的基线转录特征是否包含与治疗应答相关的多基因信息。我们分析了 45 名 TNBC 患者治疗前的单细胞 RNA 测序数据，并分别为 T 细胞、B 细胞、髓系细胞和整合免疫区室生成患者级特征。随机森林特征选择识别出与应答相关的特征，并使用 logistic regression、feedforward neural network 和 support vector machine 进行评估。整合免疫特征在开发队列中表现最好，使用 support vector machine 分类时准确率达到 0.8936，AUC 达到 0.9335。随机森林选出的基因富集于名义上的应答相关表达差异，但在错误发现率校正后，没有任何单个基因仍达到显著性。CAMERA 分析显示，应答者在全部 4 种免疫特征中均具有更高的 interferon-alpha response，而在 T 细胞和整合特征中，若干代谢和应激相关 Hallmark 特征在非应答者中更高。这些功能差异只有一部分由随机森林选出的基因体现。重新分析的若干 T 细胞随机森林特征还与 TNBC 的总生存期呈名义上的相关。在一个独立的 9 名 TNBC 患者队列中的评估显示，不同免疫特征和分类器的表现存在异质性；在若干模型中，依赖阈值的指标与 AUC 不一致。总体而言，这些结果表明，基线免疫转录特征包含与 TNBC 免疫检查点阻断应答相关的多基因信息，而整合 T 细胞、B 细胞和髓系细胞转录信息可以改善应答区分。
items.author_line: Rodríguez JR, Vargas IM, Alvarado M

items.title: Development and validation of early warning scores predicting 24-hour mortality addressing intercurrent medical interventions: a multi-centre retrospective cohort study of 2,08 million hospital encounters
items.abstract_or_text: Summary Background The National Early Warning Score (NEWS) is widely used to predict patient deterioration, but retrospective validations face intervention bias and emphasise discrimination over clinical utility. We aimed to compare NEWS's clinical net benefit against simplified scoring rules and machine learning, to determine whether simpler approaches suffice or if complex models offer meaningful advantages, and to evaluate performance heterogeneity across patient subgroups. Methods We included fifteen Danish hospitals with over 2,08 million hospital encounters representing 825,200 unique patients over five years (2018 to 2023). We compared NEWS against both simpler and more complex approaches for predicting 24h mortality: Simplified NEWS (NEWS without blood pressure and temperature), DEWS (Simplified NEWS with age and sex), and a model based on eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGB-EWS) incorporating vital signs, demographics, laboratory markers, plus medical history embeddings extracted using sentence transformers. We used propensity score weighting to mitigate intervention bias and evaluated performance using net benefit, Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC), and calibration. Findings Decision curve analysis in the overall population showed maximum net benefit differences of 1,9 additional correct mortality identifications per 10000 patients between XGB-EWS and NEWS, and 1,5 per 10,000 between NEWS and Simplified NEWS. However, stratified analyses revealed substantial heterogeneity: in the high-risk group (initial NEWS >= 7), XGB-EWS provided a maximum gain of 78,1 correct identifications per 10,000 patients compared to NEWS, while Simplified NEWS resulted in a maximum performance loss of 60,2 per 10,000. Conversely, in low-risk groups, differences were minimal. Interpretation Model complexity produced limited average clinical utility gains, concentrated among patients initially classified as high risk by NEWS. These findings support prospective trials of risk-stratified monitoring based on the first NEWS assessment, testing simplified approaches for lower-risk patients while retaining full NEWS or electronic health-record models for higher-risk patients. Funding Novo Nordisk Foundation
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；多中心临床队列】在丹麦 15 家医院、825,200 名患者和超过 2.08 million 次住院就诊中比较 NEWS、简化评分和 XGB-EWS；复杂模型的平均临床净获益有限，但在初始 NEWS≥7 的高风险人群中增益更明显。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 超大规模、多中心分析将模型性能放到决策曲线和干预偏倚背景下评估，支持按初始风险分层选择监测模型，而非简单追求整体 AUC。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：National Early Warning Score（NEWS）被广泛用于预测患者病情恶化，但回顾性验证会面临干预偏倚，并且强调区分度而非临床实用性。我们旨在比较 NEWS 与简化评分规则及机器学习方法的临床净获益，以确定更简单的方法是否足够，或复杂模型是否提供有意义的优势，并评估不同患者亚组中的性能异质性。方法：我们纳入丹麦 15 家医院超过 2,08 million 次住院就诊，代表 5 年间（2018 至 2023 年）的 825,200 名独立患者。我们比较 NEWS 与更简单和更复杂的方法预测 24 小时死亡：Simplified NEWS（去除血压和体温的 NEWS）、DEWS（加入年龄和性别的 Simplified NEWS），以及基于 eXtreme Gradient Boosting 的 XGB-EWS 模型；XGB-EWS 纳入生命体征、人口学指标、实验室指标，以及使用 sentence transformers 从病史中提取的嵌入。我们使用倾向评分加权减轻干预偏倚，并采用净获益、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）和校准评估性能。结果：在总体人群中，决策曲线分析显示，XGB-EWS 相对于 NEWS 的最大净获益差异为每 10,000 名患者多正确识别 1,9 例死亡，NEWS 相对于 Simplified NEWS 的差异为每 10,000 名患者多 1,5 例。然而，分层分析显示出显著异质性：在高风险组（初始 NEWS >= 7）中，XGB-EWS 相对于 NEWS 的最大增益为每 10,000 名患者多正确识别 78,1 例，而 Simplified NEWS 的最大性能损失为每 10,000 名患者少 60,2 例。相反，在低风险组中，差异很小。解释：模型复杂度带来的平均临床实用性增益有限，且主要集中于初始 NEWS 判定为高风险的患者。这些结果支持开展前瞻性试验，基于首次 NEWS 评估实施风险分层监测：对低风险患者测试简化方法，同时对高风险患者保留完整 NEWS 或电子健康记录模型。资助：Novo Nordisk Foundation

items.title: CellMSA: Context Modeling for Single-Cell Representation Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell transcriptomics enables profiling of cellular states at unprecedented resolution, but its high dimensionality, sparsity, and technical batch effects pose significant challenges for representation learning. Existing single-cell foundation models typically encode each cell independently or only model cells from the same batch for denoising, thereby underutilizing the rich relational information across batches and cell types to model gene expression patterns. We argue that single-cell models can benefit from more informative cell-context modeling. By comparing consistency and variation across cells, models can capture fine-grained gene-gene dependencies associated with cell states, which are essential for learning high-quality representations. Inspired by the use of multiple sequence alignment (MSA) context in protein modeling, we propose CellMSA, a single-cell representation learning framework that introduces an MSA-inspired inductive bias into transcriptomic modeling. For each target cell, CellMSA retrieves relevant cells from different batches and biologically related cell types as context, and summarizes cross-cell patterns into a context-dependent gene-pair representation. This representation is then injected into a pair-aware target-cell encoder for fine-grained representation learning. We pretrain CellMSA on a large-scale human single-cell corpus of approximately 109 million cell observations, including 65.6 million primary observations. Experiments show that our framework consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at the following repository: https://github.com/PharMolix/CellMSA.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；大规模基准】CellMSA 借鉴蛋白质建模中的 MSA 上下文，为每个目标细胞检索跨批次且生物学相关的细胞，并在约 109 million 个细胞观测（其中 65.6 million 为 primary observations）上预训练；多项基准中持续优于已有方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把跨批次、跨细胞类型的关系信息引入单细胞表示学习，数据规模极大且代码公开，方法可复现性较好。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞转录组学能够以前所未有的分辨率描绘细胞状态，但其高维度、稀疏性和技术批次效应给表示学习带来了重大挑战。现有单细胞基础模型通常独立编码每个细胞，或仅对同一批次中的细胞进行去噪建模，因此没有充分利用跨批次和跨细胞类型的丰富关系信息来建模基因表达模式。我们认为，单细胞模型可以受益于信息量更高的细胞上下文建模。通过比较细胞之间的一致性和变化，模型可以捕捉与细胞状态相关的细粒度基因—基因依赖关系，这对于学习高质量表示至关重要。受蛋白质建模中多序列比对（MSA）上下文的启发，我们提出 CellMSA，这是一种将 MSA 启发的归纳偏置引入转录组建模的单细胞表示学习框架。对于每个目标细胞，CellMSA 从不同批次和生物学相关的细胞类型中检索相关细胞，并将跨细胞模式总结为依赖上下文的基因对表示。随后，该表示被注入一个具有基因对感知能力的目标细胞编码器，用于细粒度表示学习。我们在一个大规模人类单细胞语料库上预训练 CellMSA，该语料库约包含 109 million 个细胞观测，其中包括 65.6 million 个 primary observations。实验表明，在多个基准上，我们的框架持续优于已有方法。代码可在以下仓库获取：https://github.com/PharMolix/CellMSA。
items.author_line: Suyuan Zhao, Minghao Liu, Yizhen Luo, Zaiqing Nie

items.title: EHR-RobustGym: Benchmarking and Training Agents for Robust Clinical Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: In hospital workflows, electronic health records (EHRs) are often noisy, and may not contain the evidence needed to confirm events or measurements referenced in a clinical query. Even when database retrieval succeeds, clinical agents can overlook such discrepancies and return plausible but unsupported answers. We introduce EHR-RobustGym, a scalable and interactive environment for evaluating and training robust clinical agents grounded in noisy EHRs. Built on MIMIC-IV hospital records (365K patients, 31 tables, and over 500M records), EHR-RobustGym comprises 5,486 Clean-Noise pairs spanning six clinical intents and both patient-level and population-level queries. The pairs test robustness to Record-level, Value-level, and Query-level noise, while interactive SQL/Python execution and outcome verification support trajectory collection and training. Evaluating multiple LLMs reveals substantial robustness gaps: average task success across proprietary and large-scale open-weight models drops from 62.2% on Clean questions to 37.9% on Noise questions. At k=4, pass^k consistency falls below 50% for most evaluated models, exposing instability in clinical task completion. Supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning in EHR-RobustGym improve performance, with gains generalizing to five external EHR benchmarks. Together, these results position EHR-RobustGym as a testbed for evaluating and improving the evidence-grounded robustness of clinical agents.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；临床数据基准】基于 MIMIC-IV 的 365K 名患者、31 张表和超过 500M 条记录构建 5,486 对 Clean-Noise 问题，系统测试临床智能体面对记录、数值和查询噪声的稳健性；噪声使平均任务成功率从 62.2% 降至 37.9%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准把证据一致性和交互式 SQL/Python 验证纳入临床智能体评测，并报告了跨 5 个外部 EHR 基准的训练泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 在医院工作流中，电子健康记录（EHR）通常包含噪声，并且可能没有足够证据来确认临床查询中提及的事件或测量值。即使数据库检索成功，临床智能体也可能忽视这些不一致，并返回看似合理但缺乏支持的答案。我们提出 EHR-RobustGym，这是一个可扩展、交互式的环境，用于评估和训练基于含噪 EHR、具有稳健性的临床智能体。EHR-RobustGym 构建于 MIMIC-IV 医院记录之上（365K 名患者、31 张表和超过 500M 条记录），包含 5,486 对 Clean-Noise 样本，覆盖 6 种临床意图以及患者级和人群级查询。这些样本测试记录级、数值级和查询级噪声；交互式 SQL/Python 执行和结果验证支持轨迹收集与训练。对多个大语言模型的评估显示出明显的稳健性缺口：在专有模型和大规模开放权重模型中，平均任务成功率从 Clean 问题的 62.2% 降至 Noise 问题的 37.9%。在 k=4 时，大多数评估模型的 pass^k 一致性低于 50%，暴露出临床任务完成的不稳定性。在 EHR-RobustGym 中进行监督微调和强化学习可改善性能，而且增益可泛化到 5 个外部 EHR 基准。总体而言，这些结果表明，EHR-RobustGym 可作为评估和改善临床智能体证据支撑稳健性的测试平台。
items.author_line: Yitong Qiao, Yancheng Jin, Lei Liu, Yue Shen, Jian Wang, Jinjie Gu, Zhixuan Chu

items.title: scTrilemma: Balancing Identity, Invariance, and Fidelity in Single-Cell Representation Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell RNA-seq representation learning is fundamentally label-free: cell identities, states, and contexts are not fixed training targets, so what constitutes signal or nuisance is analysis-dependent. A single representation must therefore preserve biological identity and state, remain robust to nuisance context, and retain the gene-level variation needed for expression analysis, three demands we call the representation trilemma. To tackle this problem, we introduce scTrilemma, a latent-bottleneck VAE that routes expression-derived variation to the embedding, the decoder, or the prior rather than forcing all of it through one embedding. It gates gene tokens by expression, routes the cell representation through the decoder, and conditions the prior on unlabeled pseudo-bulk context, under a single reconstruction objective and without target annotations or auxiliary representation losses. In release-based zero-shot evaluation on successive CZ CELLxGENE Census releases, scTrilemma leads all three demands at once and preserves biological-state, differential-expression, and pathway structure across multiple disease settings. Latent interventions further show that context can be removed at almost no cost to the other demands, leaving identity against fidelity as the remaining tension. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/yunhak0/scTrilemma.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；公开代码】scTrilemma 用潜在瓶颈 VAE 将表达变化分流至 embedding、decoder 或 prior，在 successive CZ CELLxGENE Census releases 上进行 zero-shot 评估，同时保持细胞身份、对上下文干扰的稳健性和基因级保真度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法明确处理单细胞表示学习中 identity、invariance 与 fidelity 的张力，且使用跨版本发布数据和公开代码，复现与外部检验条件较好。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞 RNA-seq 表示学习本质上是无标签的：细胞身份、状态和上下文并不是固定的训练目标，因此什么构成信号或干扰取决于分析目的。单一表示因此必须同时保留生物学身份和状态、对干扰性上下文保持稳健，并保留表达分析所需的基因级变化；我们将这 3 项要求称为表示三难题。为解决这一问题，我们提出 scTrilemma，这是一种潜在瓶颈 VAE，将由表达产生的变化分流至 embedding、decoder 或 prior，而不是强迫所有变化都通过同一个 embedding。它根据表达对基因 token 进行门控，使细胞表示通过 decoder，并在单一重建目标下、无需目标注释或辅助表示损失，以无标签 pseudo-bulk 上下文为 prior 提供条件。在 successive CZ CELLxGENE Census releases 的基于发布版本的 zero-shot 评估中，scTrilemma 同时领先于这 3 项要求，并在多种疾病情境下保持生物学状态、差异表达和通路结构。潜在干预进一步显示，几乎不牺牲其他要求即可移除上下文影响，剩下的主要张力是身份与保真度之间的权衡。代码公开于：https://github.com/yunhak0/scTrilemma。

items.title: Quantum Hamiltonian-Based Generative Modeling of Single-Cell Transcriptomics for Gene Regulatory Network Inference
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce a novel quantum Hamiltonian-based gene expression model (QHGM), a generative framework for modeling pseudotime-ordered single-cell gene expression data. In QHGM, gene interactions are encoded via a parameterized Hamiltonian, and the outcomes of quantum measurements provide a discrete representation of the gene expression profile. To learn the Hamiltonian parameters and infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs), we develop a scalable variational quantum algorithm for network inference (VQ-Net) based on empirical risk minimization. We derive finite-sample recovery guarantees for accurate parameter estimation, demonstrating polynomial scaling with the number of genes. Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate accurate GRN recovery, with VQ-NET achieving over 25% improvement in edge recovery and over 50% improvement in parameter-sign recovery compared to state-of-the-art classical methods. We further apply the framework to glioblastoma scRNA-seq data, where it identifies biologically plausible regulatory interactions associated with cancer progression, highlighting the potential of quantum-like modeling beyond classical probabilistic frameworks.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；计算与合成数据验证】QHGM 用参数化 Hamiltonian 表达基因互作，并以 VQ-Net 从 pseudotime 排序的单细胞表达中推断 GRN；合成数据中边恢复提高超过 25%、参数符号恢复提高超过 50%，并在胶质母细胞瘤 scRNA-seq 中发现生物学上合理的调控互作。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把量子启发的生成建模引入基因调控网络推断，并给出有限样本恢复保证；真实数据结果仍应视为计算上的生物学合理性，而非实验因果验证。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新颖的基于量子 Hamiltonian 的基因表达模型（QHGM），这是一种用于建模按 pseudotime 排序的单细胞基因表达数据的生成框架。在 QHGM 中，基因互作通过参数化 Hamiltonian 编码，量子测量的结果提供基因表达谱的离散表示。为了学习 Hamiltonian 参数并推断基因调控网络（GRN），我们开发了一个基于经验风险最小化、可扩展的网络推断变分量子算法（VQ-Net）。我们推导了准确参数估计的有限样本恢复保证，显示其随基因数呈多项式扩展。在合成数据实验中，QHGM 能够准确恢复 GRN；与最先进的经典方法相比，VQ-NET 的边恢复提高超过 25%，参数符号恢复提高超过 50%。我们进一步将该框架应用于胶质母细胞瘤 scRNA-seq 数据，识别出与癌症进展相关、在生物学上合理的调控互作，显示出量子式建模超越经典概率框架的潜力。
items.author_line: Sohail, M. A., Sudharshan, R. R., Pradhan, S. S., Rao, A.

items.title: Evidence Scaling for Zero-Shot Protein Reasoning with Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) show emerging zero-shot capability for protein variant prediction, yet still lag behind specialized protein models. We ask whether this gap can be reduced by scaling access to biological evidence rather than adapting model parameters. We introduce BioEvidence, a training-free and model-agnostic interface that converts structural and evolutionary information from standard biological tools into compact evidence for frozen LLMs. On the ProteinGym benchmark, we observe evidence scaling: performance improves as evidence becomes richer. Structural and evolutionary evidence each improve performance, and combining them yields further gains, while mismatching the same evidence to the wrong variants degrades performance below the no-evidence baseline. Notably, BioEvidence enables zero-shot ranking to reach strong specialized protein predictors on matched evaluations, and the improvement persists on post-cutoff data released after the model's knowledge cutoff. Evidence also interacts with conventional scaling: for GPT-5.6 Sol, evidence at low reasoning effort outperforms the no-evidence condition at medium effort, while a six-model analysis associates stronger no-evidence performance with larger margins over evolutionary rank fusion. These results identify external evidence as a complementary scaling axis for scientific prediction alongside model capability and inference effort.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；蛋白质预测基准】BioEvidence 将结构和进化工具产生的证据压缩后提供给冻结参数的 LLM；在 ProteinGym 上，证据越丰富性能越好，结构与进化证据结合可达到与专用蛋白模型相近的 zero-shot 排名表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果把外部生物学证据确立为独立于模型参数和推理强度的可扩展轴，并显示证据与变体匹配错误时反而会低于无证据基线。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在蛋白质变体预测中表现出新兴的 zero-shot 能力，但仍落后于专用蛋白质模型。我们考察了这样一个问题：是否可以通过扩展生物学证据的获取，而不是调整模型参数，来缩小这一差距。我们提出 BioEvidence，这是一种无需训练、与模型无关的接口，将标准生物学工具产生的结构和进化信息转换为紧凑证据，提供给参数冻结的 LLM。在 ProteinGym 基准上，我们观察到证据扩展现象：随着证据变得更丰富，性能提高。结构证据和进化证据分别都能改善性能，二者结合会带来进一步增益；而将相同证据错误匹配到不对应的变体时，性能会降至无证据基线以下。值得注意的是，在匹配的评估中，BioEvidence 使 zero-shot 排名达到强专用蛋白质预测器的水平，并且这种改善在模型知识截止时间之后发布的 post-cutoff 数据上仍然存在。证据还会与常规扩展相互作用：对于 GPT-5.6 Sol，在低推理强度下使用证据的性能优于中等推理强度下的无证据条件；对 6 个模型的分析则显示，更强的无证据性能与相对于 evolutionary rank fusion 更大的优势幅度相关。这些结果表明，外部证据是科学预测中继模型能力和推理强度之外的互补扩展轴。
items.author_line: Hao, Z., Wang, C., Li, D., Wang, Y.

items.title: Structure-guided prioritization of divergent virulence and resistance candidates in an open pangenome clinical Escherichia coli isolate
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Determining the biological function of uncharacterized hypothetical proteins is a key challenge in genomics. The accessory genome of pathogens houses sequence-divergent antimicrobial resistance (AMR) and virulence genes escaping standard nnotation. We present an integrated, structure-guided pangenome-to-structure computational pipeline combining pangenomic singleton filtering, structural prediction (ESMFold/AlphaFold3), homology searches (Foldseek/TM-align), Protein Language Model embeddings (ESM-2 650M), and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations (OpenMM). Applied to the clinical multidrug-resistant (MDR) extraintestinal pathogenic Escherichia coli (ExPEC) ST354 isolate QA5221, pangenome clustering across 32 genomes isolated 142 private singletons. Filtering prioritized four candidates in resistance/virulence superfamilies: (i) GNAT_KA27 ( KNGPFPPJ_02769 ), a divergent GCN5-related N-acetyltransferase (GNAT) with strong aminoglycoside affinity ( Delta G_bind = -22.91 kcal/mol) via MM-GBSA and 127-ns MD fold stability (RMSD = 2.73 ± 0.20 A); (ii) Ehly_61 ( KNGPFPPJ_00061 ), a putative enterohemolysin showing stable transmembrane topology (5.65 ± 1.04 A RMSD) in bilayer MD; (iii) OAgP_161 ( KNGPFPPJ_03161 ), a putative O-antigen polymerase ( Wzy ) in the LPS cluster (2.12 ± 0.23 A RMSD); and (iv) OAT_371 ( KNGPFPPJ_04371 ), a plasmid-associated outer-membrane autotransporter. All candidates feature low GC content (29.31–48.53%) and cluster distinctly in ESM-2 latent space. Phylogenetics confirms they form independent, deeply branching clades. This framework enables systematic prioritization of sequence-divergent accessory genes, flagging high-priority targets for experimental characterization. (GenBank: JCACXV000000000).
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；临床分离株计算分析】在临床多重耐药 ExPEC ST354 分离株 QA5221 的开放泛基因组中，对 32 个基因组筛得 142 个 private singletons，再结合 ESMFold/AlphaFold3、Foldseek/TM-align、ESM-2 和 OpenMM MD，优先提出 4 个潜在耐药或毒力候选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把泛基因组筛选、结构预测、同源搜索和分子动力学串成可操作的候选优先级流程，但候选功能仍需实验确认。
items.abstract_zh: 确定未表征假想蛋白的生物学功能是基因组学中的关键挑战。病原体的 accessory genome 包含序列高度分化、能够逃避标准注释的抗菌药物耐药（AMR）和毒力基因。我们提出一个整合的、结构引导的“泛基因组到结构”计算流程，结合泛基因组 singleton 过滤、结构预测（ESMFold/AlphaFold3）、同源性搜索（Foldseek/TM-align）、蛋白质语言模型嵌入（ESM-2 650M）和分子动力学（MD）模拟。该流程应用于临床多重耐药肠外致病性 Escherichia coli（ExPEC）ST354 分离株 QA5221；在 32 个基因组上进行泛基因组聚类，识别出 142 个 private singletons。过滤后，4 个候选被优先归入耐药/毒力超家族：（i）GNAT_KA27（KNGPFPPJ_02769），一种序列分化的 GCN5-related N-acetyltransferase（GNAT），通过 MM-GBSA 显示出对 aminoglycoside 的较强亲和力（Delta G_bind = -22.91 kcal/mol），并在 127-ns MD 中保持折叠稳定性（RMSD = 2.73 ± 0.20 A）；（ii）Ehly_61（KNGPFPPJ_00061），一种推定的 enterohemolysin，在双层膜 MD 中显示稳定的跨膜拓扑（5.65 ± 1.04 A RMSD）；（iii）OAgP_161（KNGPFPPJ_03161），LPS cluster 中一种推定的 O-antigen polymerase（Wzy）（2.12 ± 0.23 A RMSD）；以及（iv）OAT_371（KNGPFPPJ_04371），一种与质粒相关的外膜 autotransporter。所有候选者均具有较低 GC 含量（29.31–48.53%），并在 ESM-2 潜在空间中形成清晰分离的簇。系统发育分析证实它们形成独立且深分支的谱系。该框架能够系统地优先排序序列分化的 accessory genes，并标记出需要实验表征的高优先级靶点。（GenBank：JCACXV000000000）。
items.author_line: Benmoumou-Hosni S, Mekla A, Haleche I

items.title: From seven combination hypotheses to one testable interaction: a gated agentic AI QSP workflow applied to healthy ageing interventions
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model (LLM) agents can propose combination therapies and construct supporting mechanistic models far quicker than either can be verified. To address this gap, we built a gated agentic AI quantitative systems pharmacology (Ai QSP) workflow where no hypothesis reaches a report until it clears strict hurdles for precedent, evidence, structural integrity, and release. We applied this pipeline end to end to healthy-ageing interventions. It began with a 34 state model calibrated on clinical trial data for semaglutide and metformin. Locked and evaluated against an independent post hoc DNA methylation trial, the model captured the direction of change across all 9 organ and system clocks, but the magnitude was far too small: it predicted about 0.14 years per year where 1.6 were observed, halting tier promotion. The workflow then generated seven nutritional combination hypotheses (H1H7) with 48 new parameters encoded in SBML. Identifiability analysis showed that 37 of these were completely unconstrained by available data. Trimming the model down to its lead pairing - a food derived bioactive (Agent A) plus a single-strain probiotic (Agent B left six identifiable parameters and locked the uncalibrated interaction term at zero. From this reduced model, we derived an 84 day trial with a 28 day washout, requiring 356 participants for 80% power at an interaction ratio of 0.75. A 9,000 person virtual trial confirmed the design (80.5% power), but revealed an operational trap: an assay floor at 24 mg/kg slashed power to 33% and skewed estimates toward the null, forcing a protocol-level censoring condition before study lock. Testing the pipeline across downstream operational stages and comparative oncology programmes showed that unconstrained generation consistently over-reports novelty, topological entry points can masquerade as biological mechanism, and governance gates remain vulnerable to operator overrides. Ultimately, the workflow delivered no silver bullet: its output is a single testable interaction, an assay hardened trial design, and an audit trail documenting why the other six hypotheses were shelved. Agent identities, doses, and agent specific sources are withheld in this version pending patent filing.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；临床试验设计模拟】门控 agentic AI QSP 工作流从 7 个营养组合假设筛到 1 个可检验互作；34 状态模型在独立 DNA methylation trial 上方向正确但幅度严重不足，最终形成 356 人、84 天试验设计，并发现 assay floor 可将 power 从 80.5% 降至 33%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把可识别性、证据门槛、虚拟试验和审计轨迹纳入同一流程，明确展示生成式假设可能过度报告新颖性，不能把模型输出当作已证实机制。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体提出联合治疗方案并构建支持性机制模型的速度，远快于这些方案得到验证的速度。为应对这一差距，我们建立了一个门控式 agentic AI 定量系统药理学（Ai QSP）工作流；任何假设在通过先例、证据、结构完整性和发布的严格门槛之前，都不会进入报告。我们将该流程端到端应用于健康老龄化干预。流程始于一个 34 状态模型，该模型根据 semaglutide 和 metformin 的临床试验数据进行校准。模型被锁定后，在一个独立的事后 DNA methylation trial 上评估；它捕捉到了全部 9 个器官和系统时钟的变化方向，但幅度远远过小：模型预测每年约 0.14 年，而观察到的是 1.6 年，因此停止了层级晋升。随后，工作流生成了 7 个营养组合假设（H1H7），并在 SBML 中编码了 48 个新参数。可识别性分析显示，其中 37 个参数完全不受现有数据约束。我们将模型裁剪为其首选组合——一种食物来源 bioactive（Agent A）加上一种单菌株 probiotic（Agent B），保留 6 个可识别参数，并将未经校准的互作项锁定为 0。基于这一缩减模型，我们推导出一个 84 天试验和 28 天 washout；当互作比为 0.75 时，需要 356 名参与者才能达到 80% power。一个 9,000 人的虚拟试验确认了该设计（80.5% power），但发现了一个操作陷阱：24 mg/kg 的 assay floor 将 power 大幅削减至 33%，并使估计值偏向零效应，因此在锁定方案前必须加入方案层面的删失条件。在后续操作阶段和比较肿瘤学项目中测试该流程显示，无约束的生成会持续过度报告新颖性，拓扑学切入点可能伪装成生物学机制，而治理门控仍容易受到操作员覆盖。最终，该工作流没有提供万能方案：它的产出是一个可检验的单一互作、一个针对 assay 的强化试验设计，以及一条记录其他 6 个假设为何被搁置的审计轨迹。本版本因专利申请，暂不披露 Agent 身份、剂量和 Agent 特异性来源。
