items.title: Missing Data Governance in Real-World Cardiovascular Risk Prediction: Effects on Machine Learning Performance and Interpretability
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Machine learning has become central to data driven cardiovascular risk prediction, yet the empirical foundation of the field rests heavily on a small set of curated, open benchmark datasets that are clean, complete, and drawn from populations unlike those in which models are deployed. Reported performance therefore often reflects idealized conditions rather than the irregular, incomplete data of routine clinical practice. This study reframes the heart disease prediction problem around the data themselves: the reliability of a clinical prediction model is governed not only by the choice of algorithm but also by how the incompleteness of real-world data is handled. Methods An original dataset was assembled directly from the cardiology records of a private hospital in Denizli, Türkiye, covering patients seen between 2019 and 2024. The records were retrieved without any prior check of whether individual fields were populated, and nineteen parameters were selected with cardiology specialists. Eleven supervised learning algorithms were evaluated under four contrasting strategies for treating missing data: imputation, retention of missing values, hybrid handling with an explicit unknown category, and complete case analysis. Models were tuned by grid search with five-fold cross validation, assessed on a held-out test partition using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, and benchmarked against a majority class classifier. Explainable artificial intelligence analysis was used to examine whether the pattern of missingness itself carries information. Results Data quality governance proved decisive. Imputation and the hybrid strategy preserved predictive capability and stability, whereas deleting every incomplete record degraded performance markedly across all algorithms. Boosting ensembles were the most resilient to incomplete data, while instance based and simple probabilistic methods were the most adversely affected. Interpretability analysis showed that an indicator of unrecorded blood pressure ranked among the most influential features, so that the absence of a measurement itself acted as an informative signal. Conclusions Appropriate handling of incomplete records preserves model reliability, whereas uncritical deletion erodes it. The results argue for a shift from marginal accuracy gains on familiar benchmarks toward locally grounded, transparent models that can be trusted in the clinical environments they are meant to serve.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；真实世界临床数据】研究比较 11 种监督学习算法在不同缺失数据治理策略下的心血管风险预测表现，发现插补或显式保留缺失信息通常优于删除所有不完整记录；未记录的血压本身可能携带预测信息。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把缺失数据处理从技术细节提升为临床模型治理问题，提醒真实世界部署不能直接套用干净、完整的公开基准数据。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：机器学习已成为数据驱动心血管风险预测的核心，但该领域的实证基础很大程度上依赖少量经过整理、开放、干净且完整的基准数据集，而这些数据集来自与模型实际部署人群不同的群体。因此，已报告的性能往往反映理想化条件，而不是常规临床实践中的不规则、不完整数据。本研究围绕数据本身重新界定心脏病预测问题：临床预测模型的可靠性不仅由算法选择决定，也由如何处理真实世界数据的不完整性决定。方法：我们直接从土耳其 Denizli 一家私立医院的心脏病学记录中建立原始数据集，覆盖 2019 至 2024 年就诊患者。记录在未事先检查单个字段是否填写的情况下提取，并由心脏病学专家选择 19 个参数。我们在 4 种对待缺失数据的对比策略下评估了 11 种监督学习算法：插补、保留缺失值、带显式未知类别的混合处理，以及完整病例分析。模型通过网格搜索和 5 折交叉验证调参，在保留测试分区上使用准确率、精确率、召回率和 F1-score 评估，并与多数类分类器比较。我们使用可解释人工智能分析检查缺失模式本身是否携带信息。结果：数据质量治理具有决定性作用。插补策略和混合策略保留了预测能力与稳定性，而删除每条不完整记录会使所有算法的性能显著下降。Boosting 集成模型对不完整数据最有韧性，而基于实例的方法和简单概率方法受到的影响最大。可解释性分析显示，未记录血压的指标位列最重要特征之中，因此测量结果的缺失本身充当了一个有信息量的信号。结论：恰当处理不完整记录可以保持模型可靠性，而不加批判地删除记录会削弱可靠性。结果支持从熟悉基准上的边际准确率提升，转向在本地数据基础上建立透明、能够在目标临床环境中获得信任的模型。
items.author_line: Kara G, Polat LÖ

items.title: An auditable multimodal agentic system for sequential decision-making across the acute stroke pathway
items.abstract_or_text: Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of long term disability worldwide. Although timely reperfusion can improve outcomes, realizing this benefit requires clinicians to integrate fragmented clinical and imaging information with evolving evidence under the time pressure of emergency care, often with limited access to specialist expertise. Here we present StrokeAgent, a multimodal agentic decision-support framework designed around temporal alignment and continuous information synthesis across the acute stroke pathway. It processes clinical records, laboratory results, raw electrocardiographic (ECG) waveforms and source multimodal CT images to support emergency triage, the initial thrombolysis decision and final reperfusion planning. As information becomes available, StrokeAgent formulates and updates recommendations at each decision point, grounding each recommendation in an auditable chain of supporting findings and evidence. We evaluated the system in a curated set of 100 patients with multimodal clinical and imaging data, deliberately enriched for clinically complex reperfusion scenarios alongside standard presentations. StrokeAgent achieved 86% concordance with expert-adjudicated final decisions, exceeding the mean performance of three tool-free large language models (LLMs) and six resident and attending neurologists by 13 and 17 percentage points, respectively, under matched information content and timing. Complete pathway concordance (agreement at every applicable decision point) was 76%, with even larger margins over both comparator groups. On average, StrokeAgent completed the full decision pathway 73.9 s faster than the case level median neurologist time. In 1,200 blinded clinician assessments, StrokeAgent received higher overall clinical utility ratings than each LLM (common odds ratios, 10.8 to 16.3) and higher reasoning quality ratings, with fewer outputs judged to pose severe potential harm. StrokeAgent demonstrates the feasibility of a decision support system that integrates native multimodal data processing with auditable, evidence supported recommendations aligned with the sequential nature of acute stroke care. Prospective studies are needed to determine whether physician-supervised use improves clinical care.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；临床决策支持】StrokeAgent 在 100 个含多模态临床和影像资料的病例中处理急性卒中路径，最终决策一致率 86%、完整路径一致率 76%，比无工具 LLM 和神经科医师对照组更高，并平均快 73.9 秒；作者明确需要前瞻性研究。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该系统将原始 ECG、CT 和临床记录按时间点整合，并输出可审计证据链；当前结果是精选病例上的可行性证据，不代表已改善患者结局。
items.abstract_zh: 缺血性卒中是全球长期残疾的主要原因。尽管及时再灌注可以改善结局，但要实现这一获益，临床医师必须在急诊照护的时间压力下整合分散的临床和影像信息以及不断更新的证据，而且往往难以获得专科专家支持。我们提出 StrokeAgent，这是一种围绕时间对齐和急性卒中路径中持续信息综合设计的多模态智能体决策支持框架。它处理临床记录、实验室结果、原始心电图（ECG）波形和源多模态 CT 图像，以支持急诊分诊、初始溶栓决策和最终再灌注规划。随着信息逐步获得，StrokeAgent 在每个决策点形成并更新建议，并将每条建议与可审计的支持性发现和证据链相连接。我们在一个包含 100 名患者的整理病例集上评估该系统；这些病例有意增加了临床复杂的再灌注情形，同时保留标准病例。StrokeAgent 与专家裁定的最终决策一致率为 86%，在信息内容和时间点匹配的条件下，比 3 个无工具大语言模型（LLM）的平均表现高 13 个百分点，比 6 名住院医师和主治医师高 17 个百分点。完整路径一致率（在每个适用决策点均达成一致）为 76%，相对于两类对照的优势更大。平均而言，StrokeAgent 完成完整决策路径的时间比按病例计算的神经科医师中位时间快 73.9 秒。在 1,200 次盲法临床医师评估中，StrokeAgent 的总体临床实用性评分高于每个 LLM（共同优势比为 10.8 至 16.3），推理质量评分也更高，并且被判定具有严重潜在危害的输出更少。StrokeAgent 展示了决策支持系统整合原生多模态数据处理和可审计、证据支持的建议的可行性，并与急性卒中的序贯照护性质相匹配。仍需前瞻性研究确定在医师监督下使用该系统是否能够改善临床照护。
items.author_line: Yang, K.-C., Bao, Z., Tong, L.-S., Yuan, J., Chen, Y., Xue, X., Zhu, Y.-q., Luo, Y., Mao, X., Zheng, J., Liu, Z., Wang, Y., Zhang, Z., Ji, R., Shi, X., Peng, J., Wei, Z., Zhao, J.

items.title: Fyan: A Human--AI Harness with Semantic Auditing for Document-Level Formalization
items.abstract_or_text: We present FYAN, a human--AI harness for document-level mathematical formalization. Rather than treating theorems in isolation, FYAN coordinates an end-to-end workflow spanning specification, proof planning, logical review, Lean proof construction, knowledge curation, and validation, with support for independent supervision and human guidance. A central component is evidence-grounded semantic auditing, which assesses whether formal statements faithfully preserve their informal specifications. A language model constructs structured evidence over local correspondences, omissions, scope, and logical relations, while a deterministic validator checks this evidence and produces reproducible judgments. When a substantive but admissible deviation is accepted, FYAN requires an explicit proof-transfer obligation connecting the formal statement back to a source-facing interpretation. With the same model (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) in every stage, FYAN proves 86 of 143 FormalTCS theorems under a strict Lean check, against 69 for a general agent harness, and raises the natural-language proof score from 0.501 to 0.851. On ConsistencyCheck, its semantic audit catches more inconsistent statements than a direct LLM judge, both on labels verified against the source (recall 0.777 vs. 0.636) and on the original labels (0.873 vs. 0.820), and localizes each mismatch it reports to a specific hypothesis, conclusion, or scope. FYAN also built ODENumLib, a 9,355-line Lean library for the numerical analysis of ordinary differential equation.
items.summary_zh: FYAN 将数学文档形式化组织为规格说明、证明规划、逻辑审查、Lean 构造、知识整理和验证的一体化流程，并加入证据驱动的语义审计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它同时检验形式陈述是否忠实于非形式规格，以及 Lean 证明是否通过严格检查；在 FormalTCS 和 ConsistencyCheck 上给出了可复核的对比结果。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 FYAN，一个面向文档级数学形式化的人类—AI 协作框架。FYAN 不把定理孤立处理，而是协调覆盖规格说明、证明规划、逻辑审查、Lean 证明构造、知识整理和验证的端到端流程，并支持独立监督与人工引导。其核心组件是证据驱动的语义审计，用于评估形式陈述是否忠实保留非形式规格。语言模型围绕局部对应、遗漏、范围和逻辑关系构造结构化证据，确定性验证器则检查这些证据并产生可复现的判断。当接受实质性但允许的偏差时，FYAN 要求明确的证明迁移义务，把形式陈述连接回面向来源的解释。所有阶段使用同一个模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 时，FYAN 在严格 Lean 检查下证明了 143 个 FormalTCS 定理中的 86 个，而通用智能体框架为 69 个；自然语言证明得分也从 0.501 提升到 0.851。在 ConsistencyCheck 上，与直接的 LLM 评判器相比，其语义审计发现了更多不一致陈述：在经过来源核验的标签上召回率为 0.777 对 0.636，在原始标签上为 0.873 对 0.820，并能将报告的每个不匹配定位到具体假设、结论或范围。FYAN 还构建了 ODENumLib，这是一个包含 9,355 行 Lean 代码、用于常微分方程数值分析的库。
items.author_line: Wei Zhao, Yangshuo Zou, Chengxiang Ding, Yifan Wu, Xuchuan Wang, Zimu Mao, Lei Zhang, Tao Luo

items.title: ArgGYM: A Procedural, Engine-Verified Benchmark for Structured Defeasible Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Recent progress in large language model reasoning has been driven by benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments with automatically verifiable rewards, particularly in mathematics, code, and formal logic. These settings make model accuracy easier to evaluate and optimize, but it remains unclear how far success under fixed problem specifications and stable evaluation criteria transfers to reasoning outside such domains. Real-world reasoning often proceeds under incomplete and revisable information: conclusions may be supported provisionally, defeated by counter-evidence, reinstated by further arguments, or revised when stronger reasons become available. Reasoning of this kind is generally referred to as defeasible reasoning. We introduce ArgGYM, a procedural benchmark and RLVR-compatible training environment for structured defeasible reasoning. ArgGYM decomposes this reasoning into twelve tasks and grounds task-specific scoring in a symbolic argumentation engine that computes the formal states used to evaluate model outputs. It includes a frozen benchmark of 1,440 verified instances across fifteen curriculum configurations, two argument preference orderings (weakest-link and last-link), and two set orderings (elitist and democratic), while the same generators and verifiers can produce fresh instances for evaluation that reduces dependence on static test sets and for verifiable-reward training. On the frozen benchmark, frontier and open-weight models show sharply different reasoning profiles: they can recover substantial parts of structured answers without solving the complete task, and performance declines in later curriculum configurations with longer dependencies and more interacting structures. We release the benchmark, generators, and verifiers for reproducible evaluation and RLVR training.
items.summary_zh: ArgGYM 用符号论证引擎为可撤销推理建立程序化、引擎验证的基准和 RLVR 训练环境，覆盖 12 类任务与 1,440 个冻结实例。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 评分直接基于形式状态，生成器和验证器还能产生新实例，降低静态测试集过拟合并支持可验证奖励训练。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型推理的近期进展由基准和具有自动可验证奖励的强化学习环境推动，尤其是在数学、代码和形式逻辑领域。这些设置使模型准确率更容易评估和优化，但在固定问题规格和稳定评测标准下取得的成功，能在多大程度上迁移到这些领域之外的推理，仍不清楚。现实世界的推理通常基于不完整且可修订的信息：结论可能暂时得到支持、被反证击败、因进一步论证而恢复，或在更强理由出现时被修改。这类推理通常称为可撤销推理。我们提出 ArgGYM，一个用于结构化可撤销推理的程序化基准和兼容 RLVR 的训练环境。ArgGYM 将这类推理分解为 12 项任务，并通过符号论证引擎计算用于评估模型输出的形式状态，从而确定各任务的评分。它包含一个冻结基准，其中有 1,440 个经过验证的实例，覆盖 15 种课程配置、两种论证偏好排序（weakest-link 和 last-link）以及两种集合排序（elitist 和 democratic）；同一套生成器和验证器还可以产生新实例，用于减少对静态测试集的依赖并进行可验证奖励训练。在冻结基准上，前沿模型和开放权重模型呈现出明显不同的推理特征：它们能够恢复结构化答案的很大部分，却未必解决完整任务；在依赖链更长、交互结构更多的后期课程配置中，性能会下降。我们发布该基准、生成器和验证器，以支持可复现评测与 RLVR 训练。
items.author_line: İbrahim Ethem Deveci, Funda Tan Çalık, Barış Deniz Sağlam, Duygu Ataman

items.title: Growing an Agent/Prover Interface: Evolutionary Tool Design for Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving in Rocq and Lean
items.abstract_or_text: Recent achievements in AI-assisted mathematics require intensive interaction of agents with proof assistants to generate machine-checked proof certificates. Agents interact with proof assistants such as Rocq or Lean through an interface that controls what the agent receives from the prover and the cost of these interactions. Today, these interfaces are adapted from tools designed for humans and not optimized for agents. We propose an evolutionary method where a frontier model incrementally proposes new features and only keeps the ones that improve the overall performance of smaller models. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by growing, on a curated set of mathematical problems, \rme, a new MCP server for the Rocq prover. On the held-out test split of miniF2F-Rocq, an agent equipped with \rme outperforms both the baseline that only exposes the Rocq compiler and an established MCP server, across four models from two families, in success rate, cost per solve, and time per solve. Although evolved for Rocq, the resulting server transfers to Lean, improving cost and time per solve on a subset of PutnamBench. We release \rme and its port to Lean.
items.summary_zh: 该工作用进化式工具设计改造智能体与 Rocq/Lean 证明助手的交互接口，并发布可迁移的 MCP 服务器。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 miniF2F-Rocq 留出集上同时改善成功率、单题成本和耗时，并迁移到 PutnamBench 的 Lean 子集，评测目标清晰且有基线对照。
items.abstract_zh: 近期 AI 辅助数学的成果需要智能体密集地与证明助手交互，以生成机器检查的证明证书。智能体通过控制证明器向其提供的信息以及交互成本，来使用 Rocq 或 Lean 等证明助手。如今这些接口多由为人类设计的工具改造而来，并未针对智能体优化。我们提出一种进化式方法：由前沿模型逐步提出新功能，只保留那些能提升较小模型总体性能的功能。我们在一组精选数学问题上使用该方法构建 \rme，这是一个面向 Rocq 证明器的新 MCP 服务器。 在 miniF2F-Rocq 的留出测试集上，配备 \rme 的智能体在四个来自两个模型家族的模型上，都在成功率、单题成本和单题耗时方面超过了仅提供 Rocq 编译器的基线以及一个已有的 MCP 服务器。尽管该服务器是为 Rocq 演化得到的，所得服务器也能迁移到 Lean，在 PutnamBench 的一个子集上降低求解成本和耗时。我们发布 \rme 及其 Lean 移植版本。
items.author_line: Jules Viennot, Guillaume Baudart, Marc Lelarge

items.title: Self-Spec Verifiable Code Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) may generate unreliable code on corner cases missed by testing, while formal verification can provide machine-checkable guarantees. Recently, researchers have proposed several benchmarks to evaluate the capabilities of LLMs in generating formally verifiable code, where LLMs need to formulate formal specifications, generate the corresponding code, and verify its correctness. However, existing benchmarks have two key limitations: (I) They primarily evaluate specification and code generation stage-wise, with code generation typically conditioned on an oracle specification. This setup overlooks whether strong stage-wise performance translates into end-to-end success. (II)They mainly focus on a single proof-oriented language and mathematically structured tasks, offering limited coverage of tasks common in software development. In this paper, we introduce VeriCodeBench, a benchmark for self-spec verifiable code generation, where the LLM relies solely on its own generated specification and code throughout the entire process. VeriCodeBench contains 400 language-native problems across C, Java, Rust, and Python, covering practical concerns in software development. We evaluate specification coverage, code validity, and joint problem-level success. We further introduce CodeNova to enhance the capabilities of LLMs in self-spec verifiable code generation. CodeNova makes requirements explicit through constraint-guided specification and uses verifier feedback to guide targeted implementation repairs. Experimental results reveal that self-generated specifications remain a major bottleneck, while providing more sophisticated specifications may not necessarily lead to higher verification success rates. CodeNova substantially improves performance across all evaluation metrics, enabling Claude Sonnet 5 to achieve the strongest results under the self-spec protocol.
items.summary_zh: VeriCodeBench 测试模型能否从自身生成的规格出发完成可验证代码生成，并覆盖 C、Java、Rust、Python 的实用任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把规格生成、代码生成和验证放入端到端协议，明确暴露自生成规格这一瓶颈，并用联合成功率等指标检验改进是否真正有效。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型可能生成在测试遗漏的边界情况下不可靠的代码，而形式化验证可以提供机器可检查的保证。近期研究提出了若干基准，用于评估 LLM 生成形式上可验证代码的能力；在这些基准中，LLM 需要制定形式规格、生成相应代码并验证其正确性。然而，现有基准有两个主要局限：（I）它们主要分阶段评估规格制定和代码生成，而代码生成通常以预言式规格为条件。这忽略了分阶段的强性能是否能转化为端到端成功。（II）它们主要聚焦于单一面向证明的语言和数学结构化任务，对软件开发中的常见任务覆盖有限。本文提出 VeriCodeBench，一个面向自规格可验证代码生成的基准，其中 LLM 在整个过程中只依赖自己生成的规格和代码。VeriCodeBench 包含 400 个语言原生问题，覆盖 C、Java、Rust 和 Python，并涵盖软件开发中的实际关注点。我们评估规格覆盖率、代码有效性和问题级联合成功率。我们还提出 CodeNova，以增强 LLM 进行自规格可验证代码生成的能力。CodeNova 通过约束引导的规格制定明确需求，并利用验证器反馈指导有针对性的实现修复。实验结果表明，自生成规格仍是主要瓶颈，而提供更复杂的规格未必会带来更高的验证成功率。CodeNova 在所有评测指标上都显著提升性能，使 Claude Sonnet 5 在自规格协议下取得最强结果。
items.author_line: Jiaru Qian, Yihong Dong, Yongmin Li, Hao Zhu, Bin Gu, Ge Li

items.title: What Was Said, Not What Was 'Thought': Type-6 Logic for CoT Verification
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce Type-6 logic, a variant of dynamic epistemic logic augmented with two operators (uncertainty and recurrence), designed to model the inferential dynamics of contemporary large language model (LLM) chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Type-6 accounts for common LLM reasoning pathologies such as unlicensed revision, enthymemes, loopbacks, and unverifiable/incorrect claims. We propose a verifier based on Type-6 logic that builds a graph out the trace, and checks it against Type-6's axioms and inference rules. We evaluate our framework on LLM-generated CoTs four splits spanning formal and informal reasoning. Our verifier detects structurally unsound reasoning steps that surface-level heuristics miss, and allows for easy visualisation of the model's reasoning process. In our corpus, our verifier shows that derived contradiction is the most common hard-fail category in CoT, and that only about 3\% of the propositions of a trace have impact on the final derivation. Ablation studies show that other verification methods (LLMs-as-judges, other neurosymbolic approaches, etc.) cannot be considered interchangeable: for example, agreement between LLMs-as-judges and LINC is κ\approx 0.034, and this persists within a method across underlying models. Type-6, however, is the most agreed-with method amongst the ones we tested. We prove our verifier runs on average-case linear time; and release our logic specification and artefacts.
items.summary_zh: Type-6 logic 用动态认知逻辑建模链式思维轨迹，并以图结构检查未经授权的修订、隐含前提、回环和不可验证断言。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 验证器有形式公理、平均线性时间复杂度和公开工件，且在四个形式与非形式推理划分上报告了与其他方法的差异。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Type-6 logic，这是动态认知逻辑的一个变体，加入了两个算子（不确定性和递归），用于建模当代大型语言模型（LLM）链式思维（CoT）推理的推断动态。Type-6 logic 能描述常见的 LLM 推理病态现象，如未经许可的修订、隐含论证、回环以及不可验证或错误的断言。我们提出一种基于 Type-6 logic 的验证器：它从轨迹构建图，并依据 Type-6 的公理和推理规则进行检查。我们在四个形式与非形式推理划分上评估该框架，使用的是 LLM 生成的 CoT。验证器能够发现表层启发式方法遗漏的结构性不健全推理步骤，并支持对模型推理过程进行可视化。在我们的语料中，验证器显示“导出矛盾”是 CoT 中最常见的硬失败类别，而一条轨迹中只有约 3% 的命题会影响最终推导。消融研究表明，其他验证方法（LLM-as-a-judge、其他神经符号方法等）不能视为可互换；例如，LLM-as-a-judge 与 LINC 的一致性 κ 约为 0.034，而且在不同底层模型之间，这一现象在同一方法内部仍然存在。不过，在我们测试的方法中，Type-6 是获得最多一致认可的方法。我们证明该验证器在平均情形下以线性时间运行，并发布逻辑规格和相关工件。
items.author_line: Adrian de Wynter

items.title: Cogentic: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Proof Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: We present Cogentic, a multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems. While frontier language models can generate strong mathematical ideas in a single shot, single-shot generation is often insufficient for open problems that require exploring multiple competing conjectures, overcoming subtle technical obstructions, and retaining intermediate progress over a long horizon. Cogentic addresses these challenges through an iterative prove--verify loop in which an orchestrator allocates a population of independent provers across distinct proof directions, subjects their output to adversarial verification by several specialized components, and promotes confirmed intermediate results into a persistent verified ledger that later rounds build on. The harness is designed to be able to solve research-level math and theoretical computer science problems. Using Gemini as the base model, Cogentic produced novel results on five open problems across online learning, auction theory, and mechanism design. Each result was independently verified by domain experts and is developed in full in companion papers. We list these results, and new ones as they are verified, at https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic .
items.summary_zh: Cogentic 通过多智能体的“证明—验证”循环探索开放数学与理论计算机科学问题，并把已确认的中间结果写入持久化账本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把独立证明方向、对抗式验证和长期记忆组合起来，并报告了五个经领域专家独立核验的新结果。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Cogentic，一个用于开放研究问题自动证明发现的多智能体框架。尽管前沿语言模型一次生成就能提出有力的数学想法，但对于需要探索多个相互竞争的猜想、克服细微技术障碍并在长时间范围内保留中间进展的开放问题，单次生成往往不足。Cogentic 通过迭代式“证明—验证”循环应对这些挑战：编排器将一组独立证明器分配到不同的证明方向，对其输出进行多个专门组件的对抗式验证，并将确认的中间结果提升到持久化的已验证账本中，供后续轮次构建。该框架旨在解决研究级数学和理论计算机科学问题。以 Gemini 为基础模型时，Cogentic 在在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计领域的五个开放问题上产生了新结果。每个结果都由领域专家独立验证，并在配套论文中完整展开。我们在 https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic 列出这些结果以及后续经过验证的新结果。
items.author_line: Yang Cai, Vineet Gupta, Yanchen Jiang, Christopher Liaw, Aranyak Mehta, Grigoris Velegkas, Di Wang

items.title: Jaxolotl: A Unified High-Performance Benchmark Suite for LTL-Based Multi-Task RL
items.abstract_or_text: Training agents to follow arbitrary instructions is an important goal of multi-task reinforcement learning (RL). Linear temporal logic (LTL) provides a precise and structured formalism for specifying instructions to agents, and has been successfully adopted for training generalist multi-task policies. However, differences in implementations, task distributions, and evaluation protocols make existing methods difficult to compare, while high computational costs limit the scale and statistical reliability of experiments. We introduce Jaxolotl, a unified high-performance benchmark suite for multi-task LTL-RL to address these concerns. Jaxolotl provides a modular, end-to-end JAX implementation of six representative algorithms and four environments, together with newly curated task suites and a standardised, statistically robust evaluation protocol. By precompiling symbolic task representations into static arrays, Jaxolotl enables fully JIT-compiled training and evaluation, achieving end-to-end speedups of up to 220\times and supporting controlled comparisons at substantially greater experimental scale. We use this framework to systematically evaluate existing approaches, revealing complementary strengths and limitations: general methods capable of non-myopic reasoning struggle as the number of propositions grows, while methods with stronger scaling rely on environment-specific assumptions and suffer from myopia.
items.summary_zh: Jaxolotl 提供统一的高性能 LTL 多任务强化学习基准，规范算法、环境、任务套件和统计评测协议。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 静态编译和 JAX 实现将训练与评测加速至最高 220 倍，使更大规模、更可靠的比较成为可能，并揭示不同方法的非短视推理与扩展性权衡。
items.abstract_zh: 训练智能体遵循任意指令是多任务强化学习的重要目标。线性时序逻辑（LTL）为智能体指定指令提供了精确且结构化的形式化方法，并已用于训练通用多任务策略。然而，不同的实现、任务分布和评测协议使现有方法难以比较，而高计算成本限制了实验规模和统计可靠性。我们提出 Jaxolotl，一个统一的高性能多任务 LTL-RL 基准套件，以解决这些问题。Jaxolotl 提供六种代表性算法和四个环境的模块化端到端 JAX 实现，以及新整理的任务套件和标准化、统计稳健的评测协议。通过将符号任务表示预编译为静态数组，Jaxolotl 能够对训练和评测进行完全 JIT 编译，实现最高 220 倍的端到端加速，并支持在显著更大规模上进行受控比较。我们利用该框架系统评估现有方法，发现具有一般性的非短视推理方法在命题数量增加时表现困难，而扩展性更强的方法依赖环境特定假设并遭受短视问题。
items.author_line: Mathias Jackermeier, Jacques Cloete, Alessandro Abate

items.title: From Verification Failures to Reusable Guidance for Coding Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Coding agents need to establish that a program satisfies a specification and that the specification captures the requested behavior. We study how expert diagnosis of verification failures can become reusable guidance for this work. Our approach combines executable language definitions in the K framework with a kit of procedures for constructing specifications, repairing proofs, and auditing their adequacy. A human-guided development campaign on HumanEval, a benchmark of 164 Python programming tasks, achieves a 164/164 success rate with the semantics and the kit, measured by final AI audit Pass verdicts after two targeted repairs. To examine whether auditing detects problems that successful proofs leave unresolved, we construct 12 author-reviewed pairs of clean and defective packages. Every package passes its K proofs, and completed audits identify all defects and accept all clean packages. We then use KleverBench to test specification and proof construction for 31 programs with changed operator meanings. Comparisons with complete acceptance rules and equally long generic advice yield mixed results across two model and budget settings, motivating further work on selecting useful guidance within resource limits. Human-reviewed Optimism proofs establish expected pause reverts for six operations within declared input bounds under London semantics with unbounded gas. We report progress, difficulties, and lessons toward agents that deliver programs with checkable correctness arguments.
items.summary_zh: 该工作研究如何把专家对验证失败的诊断转化为编码智能体可复用的规格构造、证明修复和充分性审计流程。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 HumanEval 上实现 164/164，通过审计识别全部构造缺陷；同时在 KleverBench 上报告了不同模型和预算下的混合结果，保留了方法边界。
items.abstract_zh: 编码智能体需要证明程序满足规格，并且规格确实涵盖所要求的行为。我们研究如何把专家对验证失败的诊断转化为可复用的指导。我们的方法结合 K 框架中的可执行语言定义，以及一套用于构造规格、修复证明和审计其充分性的流程。在 HumanEval（一个包含 164 个 Python 编程任务的基准）上，使用这些语义和流程的人类引导开发活动实现了 164/164 的成功率，依据是两次有针对性的修复之后最终 AI 审计的 Pass 判定。为了检验审计是否能发现成功证明仍未解决的问题，我们构造了 12 对经过作者审阅的干净包和缺陷包。每个包都通过了 K 证明，而完整审计识别了全部缺陷并接受了所有干净包。随后，我们使用 KleverBench 测试对 31 个运算符含义发生变化的程序进行规格和证明构造。在两种模型和预算设置下，与完整接受规则及等长通用建议的比较结果不一，这提示仍需研究如何在资源限制内选择有用指导。经过人工审阅的 Optimism 证明，在具有无界 gas 的 London 语义下，为六个操作在声明的输入范围内建立了预期的暂停回滚性质。我们报告了朝向让智能体交付带有可检查正确性论证的程序这一目标所取得的进展、困难和经验。
items.author_line: Yuqing Zhai, Xiaohong Chen, Lingming Zhang, Sriram Vishwanath, Grigore Rosu

items.title: Does Learning Protein Folding Generalize to Broader Reasoning?
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models rely heavily on human text, which often conveys surface answers rather than the spatial and structural logic behind them. Protein folding is a natural testbed, because one solved structure yields thousands of exactly checkable spatial and topological statements. We ask: can learning to fold proteins teach general models reusable reasoning capabilities? To answer this, we build FoldingCorpus, a protein-derived question-answer dataset, and Fold2Reason, a recipe that post-trains on it through two complementary signals: discrete structural answers predicted via the model's native language head, and continuous 3D geometry decoded from the same shared representations. On FoldBench, Fold2Reason achieves structure prediction scores 2.7 to 3.5 times those of Qwen3.5-9B. Beyond protein structure prediction, it improves performance on all 10 benchmarks spanning spatial, graph, scientific, and general reasoning, raising macro-average accuracy from 45.09% to 48.33% (+3.23 pp), with positive gains on all 10 benchmarks, while matched controls built from random, synthetic, and shuffled structure yield substantially smaller or negative gains. Our work shows that non-linguistic, structure-dense scientific data can systematically improve broad reasoning in language models, making a solved scientific problem a practical source of post-training supervision.
items.summary_zh: Fold2Reason 将蛋白质折叠产生的可精确检查空间与拓扑关系转化为训练信号，检验非语言结构数据能否迁移提升通用推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 作者在 FoldBench 及 10 个空间、图、科学和通用推理基准上使用匹配控制组，报告了跨任务的正向增益，而非只展示单一领域成绩。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型高度依赖人类文本，而文本往往传达表面答案，而非其背后的空间和结构逻辑。蛋白质折叠是一个自然的测试平台，因为一个已解决的结构能够产生数千条可精确检查的空间和拓扑陈述。我们提出问题：学习折叠蛋白质能否教会通用模型可复用的推理能力？为回答这一问题，我们构建了来源于蛋白质的问答数据集 FoldingCorpus，并提出 Fold2Reason，通过两个互补信号在其上进行后训练：一是使用模型原生语言头预测离散结构答案，二是从同一共享表示中解码连续三维几何。在 FoldBench 上，Fold2Reason 的结构预测得分达到 Qwen3.5-9B 的 2.7 至 3.5 倍。除了蛋白质结构预测外，它还提升了涵盖空间、图、科学和通用推理的全部 10 个基准上的表现，使宏平均准确率从 45.09% 提高到 48.33%（提升 3.23 个百分点）；10 个基准均获得正向增益，而由随机、合成和打乱结构构成的匹配控制组带来的增益明显更小或为负。我们的工作表明，非语言、结构密集的科学数据可以系统性改善语言模型的广泛推理能力，使一个已经解决的科学问题成为实用的后训练监督来源。
items.author_line: Yong Liu, Zhanpeng Shi, Yizhou Dang, Zhongyue Zhang, Xiaoliang Shi, Zhijian Wei, Shuangjia Zheng

items.title: LogiC-Diff: Embedding Security Properties Into AI-Enabled Cyber-Physical Systems
items.abstract_or_text: AI-enabled Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) are highly vulnerable to adversarial and anomalous inputs, where small perturbations can induce cascading errors and unsafe control actions. Existing approaches, such as rule-based filtering, training-time regularization, or diffusion-based reconstruction, either operate outside the model or lack mechanisms to incorporate formal security specifications into the prediction process. In this paper, we take the first step toward embedding security properties directly into AI-enabled CPS, enabling predictive models to enforce system-level constraints during inference rather than relying on external defenses. We introduce a logic-conditioned bi-stage diffusion framework that integrates Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications into forecasting. STL serves as a first-class conditioning signal that guides both an input repair stage and an output refinement stage, allowing the model to jointly mitigate adversarial perturbations and enforce desired temporal behaviors to satisfy security-critical properties. We evaluate our approach on two real-world multivariate CPS forecasting datasets under a diverse set of physical sensor and cyber attacks. Across sensor faults, gradient-based attacks, adaptive attacks, and varying attack strengths, our method consistently improves robustness and specification compliance, degrades more gracefully as attack strength increases, and generalizes better to unseen attacks. Ablation studies on specification coverage and quality further show that embedding logical security properties yields gains unattainable by reconstruction-based methods alone, highlighting a new direction for integrating formal methods with generative models in secure CPS.
items.summary_zh: LogiC-Diff 将 Signal Temporal Logic 安全性质直接嵌入双阶段扩散预测，在输入修复和输出细化中同时约束 AI 赋能的网络物理系统。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它在两组真实多变量 CPS 数据集和多类攻击上同时报告鲁棒性与规格符合度，并用规格覆盖率消融验证形式约束的作用。
items.abstract_zh: AI 赋能的网络物理系统（CPS）高度易受对抗性和异常输入影响，微小扰动就可能引发级联错误和不安全的控制动作。现有方法，如基于规则的过滤、训练时正则化或基于扩散的重建，要么在模型之外运行，要么缺乏把形式安全规格纳入预测过程的机制。在本文中，我们首次尝试将安全性质直接嵌入 AI 赋能的 CPS，使预测模型能够在推理期间执行系统级约束，而不依赖外部防御。我们提出一种逻辑条件双阶段扩散框架，将 Signal Temporal Logic（STL）规格集成到预测中。STL 作为一等条件信号，同时引导输入修复阶段和输出细化阶段，使模型能够联合缓解对抗扰动并执行期望的时间行为，从而满足安全关键性质。我们在两个真实世界的多变量 CPS 预测数据集上，针对多种物理传感器攻击和网络攻击进行评估。在传感器故障、基于梯度的攻击、自适应攻击以及不同攻击强度下，我们的方法持续提升鲁棒性和规格符合度；随着攻击强度增加，性能下降也更平缓，并且对未见攻击具有更好的泛化能力。关于规格覆盖率和质量的消融研究进一步表明，嵌入逻辑安全性质带来的收益是仅靠重建方法无法获得的，显示出将形式方法与生成模型结合用于安全 CPS 的新方向。
items.author_line: Ziyan An, John Stankovic, Meiyi Ma

items.title: Security Properties of Neural Networks as Decision Problems
items.abstract_or_text: Certifying a deployed neural network raises decision problems that the verification literature has not classified: whether the model carries a backdoor planted in its training data, whether a fault in its stored parameters can drive it into an unsafe state, whether its output leaks a private part of its input. We formalise eight such problems and classify what we can. The organising observation is a logical one. The function computed by a piecewise linear network, together with all its node values, is definable by a quantifier-free formula of real addition of size linear in the network, so a property of the network is a quantifier-alternation sentence, which Sontag's 1985 theorem places in the polynomial hierarchy at the level of its prefix. Membership results are thus corollaries, and the argument makes plain what they need: that the quantified objects are inputs rather than the network's own parameters. Non-interference, monotonicity and counterfactual fairness have exactly the complexity of network equivalence and of interval verification, all co-NP- complete over ReLU. Detection of backdoor triggers from a quantised alphabet is Sigma_2^P-complete, one level above robustness certification, so it does not reduce to polynomially many robustness queries unless the hierarchy collapses. Inversion resistance is co-NP-complete for every l_p metric, p a fixed positive integer. Quantifying over parameters instead of inputs - the fault model of bit-flip attacks, radiation upsets and analog accelerators - makes verification exists-R-complete already for networks of identity nodes, for which every previously studied problem is in P, and it stays so when each parameter is confined to a box of inverse-polynomial width; the corresponding safety question is forall-R-complete for ReLU.
items.summary_zh: 该论文把神经网络的后门、故障、隐私泄露、单调性和公平性等安全性质形式化为决策问题，并给出复杂性分类。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果把验证难度与量词交替层级联系起来，明确区分输入量化和参数量化，为判断哪些安全性质可高效验证提供可检验的理论边界。
items.abstract_zh: 对已部署神经网络进行认证会提出验证文献尚未分类的决策问题：模型是否携带由训练数据植入的后门，存储参数中的故障是否会使模型进入不安全状态，以及模型输出是否泄露输入中的私人部分。我们形式化了八类此类问题，并对其中能够处理的部分进行了分类。核心观察是一个逻辑事实：分段线性网络计算的函数及其所有节点值，都可以由一个大小与网络线性相关的实数加法无量词公式定义；因此，网络的一个性质是一个带量词交替的句子，而 Sontag 在 1985 年的定理将其置于由前缀决定的多项式层级中。成员关系结果因此是推论，而论证明确说明了其所需条件：被量化的对象必须是输入，而不是网络自身的参数。对于 ReLU 网络，非干扰性、单调性和反事实公平性分别具有与网络等价性和区间验证相同的复杂度，均为 co-NP-complete。来自量化字母表的后门触发器检测是 Σ₂^P-complete，比鲁棒性认证高一级；因此，除非多项式层级塌缩，否则它不能归约为多项式数量的鲁棒性查询。对于每个固定的正整数 p，逆向抵抗性在任意 l_p 度量下都是 co-NP-complete。若量化对象改为参数——这对应位翻转攻击、辐射扰动和模拟加速器的故障模型——即使对仅含恒等节点的网络，验证问题也成为 ∃R-complete，而此前研究的每个问题在这类网络上都属于 P；当每个参数被限制在逆多项式宽度的盒中时，结论仍然成立；对于 ReLU，所对应的安全问题是 ∀R-complete。
items.author_line: Adrian Wurm

items.title: Beyond the Shadows of Plato's Cave: Evaluating False Memory in Autonomous Agents via Counterfactual Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Autonomous agents increasingly rely on memory to generalize beyond their training environments. However, agents are bounded by what they have seen and believed, and leveraging such memories in unseen environments can introduce biases into their internal beliefs. We formalize this phenomenon as false memory, which can arise from spurious correlations, environment shifts, and knowledge conflicts. Despite its importance, false memory is difficult to evaluate because it stems from agent internal beliefs and is easily confounded with ordinary generalization failures. Therefore, we propose FAME, a training-free framework that evaluates false memory through the evolution of agent beliefs under counterfactual reasoning. Specifically, counterfactual scenarios reveal how beliefs change as the latent concept of memory shifts under hypothetical interventions; thus, measuring the resulting concept drift provides a signal for distinguishing faithful versus false memory. Such concepts can be estimated from agent hidden states before answer generation, avoiding the need for reward design or answer sampling. Empirical experiments reveal that simply monitoring answers often fails to detect false memory, while FAME achieves AUROCs of 76.2% - 96.7% across false-memory settings, and outperforms the best baseline by 3.4% - 23.3% across realistic benchmarks, spanning math reasoning (GSM-Symbolic), code generation (GitChameleon), and complex reasoning (BigBench-Hard). We further release corresponding counterfactual templates and facilitate future research on false memory.
items.summary_zh: FAME 通过反事实干预下隐藏信念概念的漂移来评估自治智能体的“错误记忆”，避免只监测最终答案。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它在数学、代码和复杂推理基准上报告 AUROC 76.2%–96.7%，说明内部状态信号可用于检验模型是否把错误记忆带入新环境。
items.abstract_zh: 自治智能体越来越依赖记忆，以便在训练环境之外进行泛化。然而，智能体受到其所见和所信内容的限制，在未见环境中利用这些记忆可能会把偏差引入内部信念。我们将这种现象形式化为错误记忆，它可能源于虚假相关、环境变化和知识冲突。错误记忆难以评估，因为它源自智能体的内部信念，并且容易与普通的泛化失败混淆。因此，我们提出 FAME，一个无需训练的框架，通过反事实推理下智能体信念的演化来评估错误记忆。具体而言，反事实场景揭示了在假设性干预下，随着记忆的潜在概念发生变化，信念如何改变；因此，测量由此产生的概念漂移，可以作为区分忠实记忆和错误记忆的信号。这些概念可以在生成答案之前从智能体的隐藏状态中估计出来，无需设计奖励或采样答案。实验证明，仅监测答案通常无法发现错误记忆，而 FAME 在各种错误记忆设置下取得 76.2%–96.7% 的 AUROC，并在涵盖数学推理（GSM-Symbolic）、代码生成（GitChameleon）和复杂推理（BigBench-Hard）的真实基准上超过最佳基线 3.4%–23.3%。我们还发布相应的反事实模板，以促进未来研究。
items.author_line: Quan M. Tran, Zhuo Huang, Zhen Fang, Jing Zhang, Mingming Gong, Tongliang Liu

items.title: Taming Speculative Search for Test-Time Scaling in LLM Serving
items.abstract_or_text: Test-time scaling has recently emerged as a powerful approach for improving LLM reasoning by allocating additional computation during inference, substantially enhancing accuracy on challenging tasks such as mathematics and coding. To accelerate the exploration of reasoning paths, recent studies proposed speculative execution. However, we show that supporting speculative execution poses two unique challenges for LLM serving systems: (1) an explosion in the search space of candidate paths and (2) frequent, fine-grained verification tasks for candidates. To address these challenges, this paper proposes SpecScale, a serving system for efficient speculative execution. We introduce three techniques to reconcile the trade-off between latency and computational overhead: (1) early pruning of low-quality candidate paths, (2) deduplicating computation across redundant candidate paths, and (3) deferring fine-grained verification tasks. We evaluate SpecScale on challenging reasoning benchmarks, including MATH and Olympiad. Our results show that SpecScale significantly outperforms both non-speculative and recent speculative approaches, delivering substantial improvements in throughput and latency while preserving answer quality.
items.summary_zh: SpecScale 面向推测式搜索的测试时扩展，使用候选路径早期剪枝、计算去重和延后验证，在 MATH 与 Olympiad 上提高吞吐并降低延迟。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把数学推理中的额外计算转化为可测的服务系统开销，并在保持答案质量的同时报告吞吐和延迟对照。
items.abstract_zh: 测试时扩展近年来成为提升 LLM 推理能力的有力方法：通过在推理期间分配额外计算，它显著提高了数学和代码等困难任务上的准确率。为加速推理路径的探索，近期研究提出了推测执行。然而，支持推测执行给 LLM 服务系统带来两个独特挑战：（1）候选路径搜索空间爆炸；（2）对候选路径进行频繁且细粒度的验证任务。为应对这些挑战，本文提出高效支持推测执行的服务系统 SpecScale。我们引入三种技术来协调延迟与计算开销之间的权衡：（1）提前剪枝低质量候选路径；（2）对冗余候选路径之间的计算进行去重；（3）延后细粒度验证任务。我们在包括 MATH 和 Olympiad 在内的困难推理基准上评估 SpecScale。结果显示，在保持答案质量的同时，SpecScale 相比非推测方法和近期推测方法都显著提升吞吐并降低延迟。
items.author_line: Jinwoo Jeong, Woohyung Choi, Myeongjae Jeon, Jeongseob Ahn

items.title: Conditional Generation of Creative Chess Puzzles with Diffusion Models
items.abstract_or_text: While modern language models demonstrate impressive generative capabilities, they often struggle with constrained, counter-intuitive creative tasks. To address this limitation, we explore chess puzzle generation as a rigorous testbed for computational creativity and reasoning, a domain where altering a single piece can invalidate an entire solution. We propose a novel approach for conditional generation of creative chess puzzles using masked diffusion models. Unlike previous methods, our non-directional diffusion approach allows for conditioning on specific tactical themes and partial board positions. We introduce a novel auxiliary task of simultaneous best-move prediction, which improves solution uniqueness by 11.6% and theme-conditioning accuracy by 2.5%. To further optimize solution uniqueness and theme conditioning, we establish a reinforcement learning framework adapted from Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO). This RL training increases the yield of unique and theme-matching positions by 89.1%. Finally, we release the first open-weights models (Appendix B) for chess puzzle generation, offering a new pathway for controllable, creative generation.
items.summary_zh: 该工作把国际象棋谜题生成作为严格的创造性与推理测试，提出带战术主题和局面条件的掩码扩散生成及 DDPO 优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 最佳着法预测、主题条件准确率和唯一解比例都有明确指标，且发布开放权重模型，结果可复验。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管现代语言模型展现出令人印象深刻的生成能力，但它们往往难以处理受约束且反直觉的创造性任务。为应对这一局限，我们探索使用国际象棋谜题生成作为计算创造性和推理的严格测试平台；在这一领域中，移动一个棋子就可能使整个解答失效。我们提出一种使用掩码扩散模型有条件生成创造性国际象棋谜题的方法。与以往方法不同，我们的非方向性扩散方法可以根据特定战术主题和部分棋盘局面进行条件控制。我们引入同时预测最佳着法这一辅助任务，使解的唯一性提高 11.6%，主题条件准确率提高 2.5%。为进一步优化解的唯一性和主题条件，我们建立了一个改造自 Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization（DDPO）的强化学习框架。该 RL 训练使独特且符合主题的局面产出量提高 89.1%。最后，我们发布首批用于国际象棋谜题生成的开放权重模型（附录 B），为可控的创造性生成提供新路径。
items.author_line: Aatu Selkee, Severi Rissanen, Xidong Feng, Tom Zahavy, Eric Malmi

items.title: The Concrete-Arbitrary Gap: Kinship Reasoning in LLMs Is Not Indifferent to Presentation
items.abstract_or_text: We test whether large language models solve formally matched kinship problems equally well when relations are expressed in familiar vocabulary or by explicitly defined nonce predicates. Across 500 paired graphs, concrete accuracy exceeds arbitrary accuracy by 35.6 percentage points in local Qwen3.8-27B, 26.6 in Gemma 4 26B-A4B, 12.0 in Gemma 4 31B, and 5.4 in Qwen3.8-Max. All four paired gaps are statistically resolved. Reasoning budgets and prompt-language interventions can substantially reduce the difference, showing that it is modifiable rather than a fixed incapacity. The minimal conclusion is behavioral: on these tasks, the models' manifested relational competence is not indifferent to presentation. Explicit definitions provide the formal relations but do not make nonce predicates as usable as familiar vocabulary embedded in learned linguistic associations.
items.summary_zh: 该研究用形式匹配的亲属关系图比较熟悉词汇与显式定义的无意义谓词，发现模型的关系推理对表达方式敏感。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 500 对图和四个模型的准确率差异提供了直接行为证据，并显示推理预算与提示语言干预能够缩小差距。
items.abstract_zh: 我们测试大型语言模型在两种形式完全匹配的亲属关系问题上的求解是否同样准确：一种用熟悉词汇表达关系，另一种用明确定义的无意义谓词表达关系。在 500 对匹配图上，具体表达的准确率高于任意表达：在本地 Qwen3.8-27B 上高 35.6 个百分点，在 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 上高 26.6 个百分点，在 Gemma 4 31B 上高 12.0 个百分点，在 Qwen3.8-Max 上高 5.4 个百分点。四组匹配差异都具有统计显著性。推理预算和提示语言干预能够显著缩小差异，说明这不是固定的能力缺失，而是可改变的现象。最低限度的结论是一个行为层面的结论：在这些任务上，模型表现出的关系能力并不对表达方式不敏感。显式定义虽然提供了形式关系，但并不能让无意义谓词像嵌入习得语言关联中的熟悉词汇那样易于使用。
items.author_line: Thomas Pashby

items.title: @fchollet：The critical distinction between base LLMs (2024 and earlier) and modern LRMs is not symbolic tool use. It's the switch
items.abstract_or_text: The critical distinction between base LLMs (2024 and earlier) and modern LRMs is not symbolic tool use. It's the switch from a transductive paradigm (intuit the answer to the query) to an inductive paradigm (intuit the program/instructions that produce the answer to the query). They're trained to be inductive, and they perform test-time induction, i.e. test-time prediction of a NL program / reasoning chain. This unlocks entirely new capabilities -- in particular fluid intelligence. Base LLMs, to this day, have ~0 fluid intelligence. LRMs have substantial levels of fluid intelligence. The performance of LLMs on ARC 1 (a benchmark from 2019) remains ~10-15% today. Scaling them up by a factor ~100,000x got them from 0% to 10%. Meanwhile LRMs the same size or smaller saturated ARC 1 in 2025.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 认为，现代长思维模型（LRM）与基础大语言模型的关键差异，在于从直接猜答案转向在测试时归纳生成程序或推理链；他以 ARC-1 表现对比说明这种范式变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是研究者对 LRM 能力来源的明确技术判断，并给出了 ARC-1 等可核查基准数据；文中结论属于作者观点，不应视为独立验证结果。
items.abstract_zh: 基础 LLM（2024 年及更早）与现代 LRM 的关键区别并非符号工具使用，而是从传导式范式（直觉式给出查询答案）转向归纳式范式（直觉式生成产生答案的程序/指令）。它们经过归纳式训练，并执行测试时归纳，即在测试时预测自然语言程序/推理链。这解锁了全新的能力，尤其是流体智力。时至今日，基础 LLM 的流体智力约为 0。LRM 具有相当程度的流体智力。LLM 在 ARC-1（2019 年的一个基准）上的表现今天仍约为 10%–15%。把它们扩大约 100,000 倍，只让表现从 0% 提升到 10%。与此同时，同等或更小规模的 LRM 在 2025 年已将 ARC-1 做到饱和。
items.author_line: François Chollet

items.title: @AnthropicAI：In physics, an “impedance mismatch” occurs when two systems each work well but are poorly matched. In this Science Blog
items.abstract_or_text: In physics, an “impedance mismatch” occurs when two systems each work well but are poorly matched. In this Science Blog guest post, Harvard physicist Matthew Schwartz argues that something similar is happening with AI and science. LLMs are capable at many things, but working with them as you would with a human collaborator isn’t currently the best way to elicit their scientific strengths. To address this mismatch, Schwartz created a toolkit for exact calculations in quantitative science. Because similar calculations often emerge in very different areas of science, Claude found connections to ecology, population genetics, and a dozen other fields, and Schwartz worked with domain experts to steer it towards interesting questions. Read more about these projects here:
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 转发哈佛物理学家 Matthew Schwartz 的观点：当前人与 LLM 的协作方式与模型在科学计算中的优势存在“阻抗失配”，他据此开发了定量科学精确计算工具包。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 内容提出了具体的人机协作问题，并给出跨生态学、群体遗传学等领域的工具实践；这是作者及 Anthropic 对工作流的判断。
items.abstract_zh: 在物理学中，“阻抗失配”指两个系统各自运行良好，但彼此匹配不佳。在这篇 Science Blog 客座文章中，哈佛物理学家 Matthew Schwartz 认为，人工智能与科学之间也存在类似情况。LLM 能完成许多事情，但目前按照与人类合作者相同的方式与它们协作，并不是激发其科学优势的最佳方法。为解决这种失配，Schwartz 创建了一个用于定量科学精确计算的工具包。由于相似的计算常常出现在截然不同的科学领域，Claude 发现了它们与生态学、群体遗传学及十几个其他领域之间的联系，Schwartz 则与领域专家合作，引导它探索有趣的问题。

items.abstract_or_text: Most of today’s coding benchmarks hand the agent a concrete task: here's a repo, here's a GitHub issue, fix ~this~ bug. Humans have already done the hardest part in noticing and describing the problem to be solved. SWE-sweep removes the ticket and tests if the agent can find the work itself. The agent gets a real repo (built from 100 open-source projects, 4k+ real bugs) and is given one instruction: find and fix as many bugs as you can. The results are very interesting: the top of the leaderboard model fixes just 4.7%. If you instead give it the original issue texts, these score can jump to 70%+. Full paper:
items.summary_zh: Claire Zhou 介绍 SWE-sweep 基准：让编码代理在100个开源项目、4000多个真实缺陷中自行发现待修问题，而不是直接提供 GitHub 工单。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该设计区分了“解决已描述问题”和“主动发现问题”两种能力，并报告了4.7%与70%以上的性能差距，是具有方法学价值的基准讨论。
items.abstract_zh: 如今大多数编码基准都会给代理一个明确任务：这里有一个代码仓库，这里有一个 GitHub 工单，请修复这个 bug。人类已经完成了发现并描述待解决问题这一最困难的部分。SWE-sweep 移除了工单，测试代理能否自行找到工作。代理面对的是一个真实代码仓库（由 100 个开源项目、4000 多个真实 bug 构成），并只得到一条指令：尽可能修复更多 bug。结果非常有意思：排行榜第一的模型只能修复 4.7%。如果改为提供原始问题文本，这一分数可以跃升至 70% 以上。完整论文：

items.title: PyTorch 2.14.1 Release
items.abstract_or_text: This release is meant to fix the following regressions and silent correctness issues: ## Silent correctness fixes - Fix incorrect `torch.linalg.lstsq` solutions on MPS for complex batched underdetermined systems ([#196113](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/196113)), fixed by [#196128](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/196128) - Fix non-orthogonal `U` and inaccurate small singular values from `torch.linalg.svd` on MPS for rank-deficient and ill-conditioned inputs ([#196112](https://…
items.summary_zh: PyTorch 发布 2.14.1，修复 MPS 上复数批量欠定系统的 `linalg.lstsq` 与 SVD 正确性问题，并更新 CUDA 13.2.2 二进制以规避可能产生错误结果的 CUDA 缺陷。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是面向科学计算和训练基础设施的正确性修复，直接关系到 Apple Silicon 与 CUDA 环境中的数值可信度，适合使用 MPS、CUDA 13.2 或线性代数算子的团队优先评估。属于聚焦型补丁版本，但后端差异仍可能影响结果与性能，升级后应重跑数值基准和关键模型回归。
items.abstract_zh: PyTorch 2.14.1 用于修复回归和静默正确性问题：修正 MPS 上复数批量欠定系统的 `torch.linalg.lstsq` 解、秩亏或病态输入的 SVD 正交性与小奇异值精度；将 Linux CUDA 13.2 二进制更新到 CUDA 13.2.2，以规避 cuBLAS NVFP4 缩放被忽略和编译器线程重汇合失败导致错误结果的缺陷；同时修复大于 8192 个元素时 MPS 线性代数算子的失败。
